title.zh: 卷九十三 列傳第四十三: 婁師德 王孝傑 唐休璟 張仁願 薛訥 王晙
title.en: Volume 93 Biographies 43: Lou Shide, Wang Xiaojie, Tang Xiujing, Zhang Renyuan, Xue Ne, Wang Jun
title.raw: 卷九十三 列傳第四十三: 婁師德 王孝傑 唐休璟 張仁願 薛訥 王晙 Volume 93 Biographies 43: Lou Shide, Wang Xiaojie, Tang Xiujing, Zhang Renyuan, Xue Ne, Wang Jun

sentences.zh: 婁師德，鄭州原武人也。

translations.literal: Lou Shide was a native of Yuanwu in Zheng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Lou Shide was a native of Yuanwu in Zheng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 弱冠，進士擢第，授江都尉。

translations.literal: At his coming of age he passed the jinshi examination and was appointed magistrate of Jiangdu.
translations.idiomatic: At his coming of age he passed the jinshi examination and was appointed magistrate of Jiangdu.

sentences.zh: 揚州長史盧承業奇其才，嚐謂之曰：「吾子台輔之器，當以子孫相托，豈可以官屬常禮待也？」

translations.literal: Lu Chengye, the prefectural secretary of Yangzhou, marveled at his talent and once said to him: "You are material for the highest offices. I ought to entrust my descendants to you—how could I treat you with the ordinary courtesies owed a subordinate official?"
translations.idiomatic: Lu Chengye, prefectural secretary of Yangzhou, marveled at his talent and once said to him, "You are material for the highest offices. I ought to entrust my descendants to you—how could I treat you with the ordinary courtesies owed a subordinate official?"

sentences.zh: 上元初，累補監察御史。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Shangyuan era he was repeatedly promoted to supervising censor.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Shangyuan era he was repeatedly promoted to supervising censor.

sentences.zh: 屬吐蕃犯塞，募猛士以討之，師德抗表請爲猛士。

translations.literal: When the Tibetans raided the frontier, brave warriors were recruited to attack them, and Shide submitted a memorial requesting to serve as one of the brave warriors.
translations.idiomatic: When the Tibetans raided the frontier, brave warriors were recruited to attack them, and Shide submitted a memorial volunteering to serve among them.

sentences.zh: 髙宗大悅，特假朝散大夫，眾軍西討，頻有戰功，遷殿中侍御史，兼河源軍司馬，並知營田事。

translations.literal: Emperor Gaozong was greatly pleased and specially granted him the provisional rank of Palace Gentleman for Dispersing Affairs. Leading the armies west in punitive action, he repeatedly won battle merit, was promoted to palace censor, and concurrently served as army marshal of the Heyuan Army while overseeing agricultural garrison affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Gaozong was greatly pleased and specially granted him the provisional rank of Palace Gentleman for Dispersing Affairs. Leading the armies west in punitive action, he won repeated battle honors, was promoted to palace censor, and concurrently served as army marshal of the Heyuan Army while overseeing agricultural garrison affairs.

sentences.zh: 天授初，累授左金吾將軍，兼檢校豐州都督，仍依舊知營田事。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Tianshou era he was repeatedly appointed Left Golden Guard General and concurrently acting inspector-general of Feng Prefecture, still overseeing agricultural garrison affairs as before.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Tianshou era he was repeatedly appointed Left Golden Guard General and concurrently acting inspector-general of Feng Prefecture, still overseeing agricultural garrison affairs as before.

sentences.zh: 則天降書勞曰：「卿素積忠勤，兼懷武略，朕所以寄之襟要，授以甲兵。

translations.literal: Empress Wu sent a letter of commendation, saying: "You have long accumulated loyal diligence and also possess military strategy. That is why I entrust you with a vital post and confer arms upon you.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Wu sent a letter of commendation, saying, "You have long accumulated loyal diligence and also possess military strategy. That is why I entrust you with a vital post and confer arms upon you.

sentences.zh: 自卿受委北陲，總司軍任，往還靈、夏，檢校屯田，收率既多，京坻遽積。

translations.literal: Since you were entrusted with the northern frontier and took overall charge of military duties, going back and forth between Ling and Xia and inspecting garrison agriculture, your collections were abundant and the capital granaries were swiftly filled.
translations.idiomatic: Since you were entrusted with the northern frontier and took overall charge of military duties, traveling between Ling and Xia and inspecting garrison agriculture, your collections were abundant and the capital granaries were swiftly filled.

sentences.zh: 不煩和糴之費，無復轉輸之艱，兩軍及北鎮兵數年鹹得支給。

translations.literal: Without the expense of purchased grain or the hardship of transport, the two armies and the northern garrison troops were all supplied for several years.
translations.idiomatic: Without the expense of purchased grain or the hardship of transport, the two armies and the northern garrison troops were supplied for several years.

sentences.zh: 勤勞之誠，久而彌著，覽以嘉尚，欣悅良深。」

translations.literal: Your diligent sincerity, the longer it endures the more it stands out. Reading of it I am greatly pleased and deeply gratified."
translations.idiomatic: Your diligent sincerity grows more evident with time. Reading of it I am greatly pleased and deeply gratified."

sentences.zh: 長壽元年，召拜夏官侍郎、判尚書事。

translations.literal: In the first year of Changshou he was summoned and appointed Vice Minister of the Ministry of War and acting director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Changshou he was summoned and appointed Vice Minister of the Ministry of War and acting director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 明年，同鳳閣鸞台平章事。

translations.literal: The next year he became Grand Chancellor of the Phoenix Pavilion and Crane Terrace.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he became Grand Chancellor of the Phoenix Pavilion and Crane Terrace.

sentences.zh: 則天謂師德曰：「王師外鎮，必藉邊境營田，卿須不憚劬勞，更充使檢校。」

translations.literal: Empress Wu said to Shide: "When imperial armies are stationed abroad, they must rely on frontier garrison agriculture. You must not shrink from toil and must again serve as commissioner to inspect it."
translations.idiomatic: Empress Wu said to Shide, "When imperial armies are stationed abroad, they must rely on frontier garrison agriculture. You must not shrink from toil and must again serve as commissioner to inspect it."

sentences.zh: 又以爲河源、積石、懷遠等軍及河、蘭、鄯、廓等州檢校營田大使。

translations.literal: He was also appointed commissioner to inspect garrison agriculture for the Heyuan, Jishi, Huaiyuan, and other armies and for He, Lan, Shan, and Kuo prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: He was also appointed commissioner to inspect garrison agriculture for the Heyuan, Jishi, Huaiyuan, and other armies and for He, Lan, Shan, and Kuo prefectures.

sentences.zh: 稍遷秋官尚書。

translations.literal: He was gradually promoted to Minister of the Ministry of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: He was gradually promoted to Minister of the Ministry of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 萬歳登封元年，轉左肅政御史大夫，仍並依舊知政事。

translations.literal: In the first year of Wansui Dengfeng he was transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief of the Bureau of Integrity and still continued to manage state affairs as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Wansui Dengfeng he was transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief of the Bureau of Integrity and still continued to manage state affairs as before.

sentences.zh: 證聖元年，吐蕃寇洮州，令師德與夏官尚書王孝傑討之，與吐蕃大將論飲陵、讚婆戰於素羅汗山，官軍敗績，師德貶授原州員外司馬。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhengsheng the Tibetans raided Tao Prefecture. Shide was ordered to join Minister of War Wang Xiaojie in attacking them. At Mount Suluohan they fought the Tibetan generals Lun Qinling and Zanpo. The imperial army was defeated, and Shide was demoted to acting magistrate of Yuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Zhengsheng the Tibetans raided Tao Prefecture. Shide was ordered to join Minister of War Wang Xiaojie in attacking them. At Mount Suluohan they fought the Tibetan generals Lun Qinling and Zanpo. The imperial army was defeated, and Shide was demoted to acting magistrate of Yuan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 萬歳通天二年，入爲鳳閣侍郎、同鳳閣鸞台平章事。

translations.literal: In the second year of Wansui Tongtian he entered the capital as Vice Minister of the Phoenix Pavilion and Grand Chancellor of the Phoenix Pavilion and Crane Terrace.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Wansui Tongtian he entered the capital as Vice Minister of the Phoenix Pavilion and Grand Chancellor of the Phoenix Pavilion and Crane Terrace.

sentences.zh: 是歳，兼檢校右肅政御史大夫，仍知左肅政台事，以與王懿宗、狄仁傑分道安撫河北諸州。

translations.literal: That year he was also appointed acting Right Censor-in-Chief of the Bureau of Integrity and still directed affairs of the Left Bureau of Integrity, and together with Wang Yizong and Di Renjie he was sent in separate routes to pacify the prefectures of Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: That year he was also appointed acting Right Censor-in-Chief of the Bureau of Integrity and still directed affairs of the Left Bureau of Integrity, and together with Wang Yizong and Di Renjie he was sent in separate routes to pacify the prefectures of Hebei.

sentences.zh: 神功元年，拜納言，累封譙縣子。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shengong he was appointed Chief Minister and enfeoffed as Viscount of Qiao County.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shengong he was appointed Chief Minister and enfeoffed as Viscount of Qiao County.

sentences.zh: 尋詔師德充隴右諸軍大使，仍檢校河西營田事。

translations.literal: Soon he was ordered to serve as commissioner of the armies of Longyou and still to inspect garrison agriculture in Hexi.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was ordered to serve as commissioner of the armies of Longyou and still to inspect garrison agriculture in Hexi.

sentences.zh: 聖曆二年，突厥入寇，復令檢校并州長史，仍充天兵軍大總管。

translations.literal: In the second year of Shengli the Turks invaded, and he was again ordered to inspect the prefectural governor of Bing and to serve as grand general of the Tianbing Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Shengli the Turks invaded, and he was again ordered to inspect the prefectural governor of Bing and to serve as grand general of the Tianbing Army.

sentences.zh: 是歳九月卒，贈涼州都督，諡曰貞。

translations.literal: That year, in the ninth month, he died. He was posthumously appointed Governor of Liang Prefecture and given the posthumous title Zhen.
translations.idiomatic: That year, in the ninth month, he died. He was posthumously appointed Governor of Liang Prefecture and given the posthumous title Zhen.

sentences.zh: 初，狄仁傑未入相時，師德嚐薦之，及爲宰相，不知師德薦已，數排師德，令充外使。

translations.literal: Earlier, before Di Renjie entered the chancellorship, Shide had once recommended him. When Renjie became chancellor he did not know that Shide had recommended him and repeatedly pushed Shide aside, sending him out as a foreign envoy.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, before Di Renjie entered the chancellorship, Shide had once recommended him. When Renjie became chancellor he did not know that Shide had recommended him and repeatedly pushed Shide aside, sending him out as a foreign envoy.

sentences.zh: 則天嚐出師德舊表示之，仁傑大慚，謂人曰：「吾爲婁公所含如此，方知不逮婁公遠矣。」

translations.literal: Empress Wu once produced Shide's old memorial and showed it to him. Renjie was deeply ashamed and said to others: "I was so contained by Lord Lou, and only now do I know how far I fall short of Lord Lou."
translations.idiomatic: Empress Wu once produced Shide's old memorial and showed it to him. Renjie was deeply ashamed and said to others, "I was so contained by Lord Lou, and only now do I know how far I fall short of Lord Lou."

sentences.zh: 師德頗有學涉，器量寬厚，喜怒不形於色。

translations.literal: Shide was broadly learned, magnanimous in capacity, and did not show anger or joy on his face.
translations.idiomatic: Shide was broadly learned, magnanimous in capacity, and did not show anger or joy on his face.

sentences.zh: 自專綜邊任，前後三十餘年，恭勤接下，孜孜不怠。

translations.literal: From the time he took sole charge of frontier duties, more than thirty years passed in which he respectfully and diligently received subordinates and worked tirelessly without slackening.
translations.idiomatic: From the time he took sole charge of frontier duties, more than thirty years passed in which he respectfully and diligently received subordinates and worked tirelessly without slackening.

sentences.zh: 雖參知政事，深懷畏避，竟能以功名始終，甚爲識者所重。

translations.literal: Although he participated in managing state affairs, he deeply feared and avoided prominence, yet in the end he preserved his reputation and office from beginning to end, and men of discernment greatly valued him.
translations.idiomatic: Although he participated in managing state affairs, he deeply feared and avoided prominence, yet in the end he preserved his reputation and office from beginning to end, and men of discernment greatly valued him.

sentences.zh: 王孝傑，京兆新豐人也。

translations.literal: Wang Xiaojie was a native of Xinfeng in Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xiaojie was a native of Xinfeng in Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 髙宗末，爲副總管，從工部尚書劉審禮西討吐蕃，戰於大非川，爲賊所獄。

translations.literal: At the end of the Gaozong reign he served as deputy grand general and followed Minister of Works Liu Shenli west to attack the Tibetans. They fought at the Da Fei River and were captured by the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Gaozong reign he served as deputy grand general and followed Minister of Works Liu Shenli west to attack the Tibetans. They fought at the Da Fei River and were captured by the enemy.

sentences.zh: 吐蕃讚普見孝傑，垂泣曰：「貌類吾父。」

translations.literal: When the Tibetan tsenpo saw Xiaojie he wept and said: "Your appearance resembles my father."
translations.idiomatic: When the Tibetan tsenpo saw Xiaojie he wept and said, "Your appearance resembles my father."

sentences.zh: 厚加敬禮，由是免死，尋得歸。

translations.literal: He treated him with great respect and courtesy, and thereby Xiaojie escaped death and soon returned home.
translations.idiomatic: He treated him with great respect and courtesy, and thereby Xiaojie escaped death and soon returned home.

sentences.zh: 則天時，累遷右鷹揚衛將軍。

translations.literal: In Empress Wu's time he was repeatedly promoted to General of the Right Eagle-Flying Guard.
translations.idiomatic: In Empress Wu's time he was repeatedly promoted to General of the Right Eagle-Flying Guard.

sentences.zh: 孝傑久在吐蕃中，悉其虛實。

translations.literal: Xiaojie had long been among the Tibetans and knew their strengths and weaknesses in full.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaojie had long been among the Tibetans and knew their situation in full.

sentences.zh: 長壽元年，爲武威軍總管，與左武衛大將軍阿史那忠節率眾以討吐蕃，乃克復龜茲、於闐、疏勒、碎葉四鎮而還。

translations.literal: In the first year of Changshou he was grand general of the Wuwei Army and, with Grand General of the Left Martial Guard Ashina Zhongjie, led troops to attack the Tibetans, recovering the four garrisons of Kucha, Khotan, Kashgar, and Suyab before returning.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Changshou he was grand general of the Wuwei Army and, with Grand General of the Left Martial Guard Ashina Zhongjie, led troops to attack the Tibetans, recovering the four garrisons of Kucha, Khotan, Kashgar, and Suyab before returning.

sentences.zh: 則天大悅，謂侍臣曰：「昔貞觀中貝綾，得此蕃城，其後西陲不守，並陷吐蕃。

translations.literal: Empress Wu was greatly pleased and said to her attending ministers: "In the Zhenguan era Pei Lin obtained these barbarian cities, but afterward the western frontier was not held and all fell to the Tibetans.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Wu was greatly pleased and said to her attending ministers, "In the Zhenguan era Pei Lin obtained these barbarian cities, but afterward the western frontier was not held and all fell to the Tibetans.

sentences.zh: 今既盡復於舊，邊境自然無事。

translations.literal: Now they have all been fully recovered as of old, and the borderlands will naturally be without trouble.
translations.idiomatic: Now they have all been fully recovered as of old, and the borderlands will naturally be without trouble.

sentences.zh: 孝傑建斯功效，竭此款誠，遂能裹足徒行，身與士卒齊力。

translations.literal: Xiaojie achieved this merit, exhausted this sincere devotion, and was able to bind his feet and walk on foot, exerting himself together with the soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaojie achieved this merit and showed such sincere devotion that he bound his feet and walked on foot, exerting himself together with the soldiers.

sentences.zh: 如此忠懇，深是可嘉。」

translations.literal: Such loyal earnestness is deeply worthy of praise."
translations.idiomatic: Such loyal earnestness is deeply worthy of praise."

sentences.zh: 乃拜孝傑爲左衛大將軍。

translations.literal: Thereupon Xiaojie was appointed Grand General of the Left Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Xiaojie was appointed Grand General of the Left Guard.

sentences.zh: 明年，遷夏官尚書、同鳳閣鸞台三品，封淸源男。

translations.literal: The next year he was promoted to Minister of War and Third Rank of the Phoenix Pavilion and Crane Terrace, and enfeoffed as Baron of Qingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was promoted to Minister of War and Third Rank of the Phoenix Pavilion and Crane Terrace, and enfeoffed as Baron of Qingyuan.

sentences.zh: 延載初，入爲瀚海道行軍總管，餘如故。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yanzai he entered service as marching grand general of the Hanhai Circuit, with the rest as before.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Yanzai he entered service as marching grand general of the Hanhai Circuit, with the rest as before.

sentences.zh: 證聖初，又爲朔方道總管，尋坐與吐蕃戰敗免官。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Zhengsheng he again served as grand general of the Shuofang Circuit, but soon was dismissed from office for defeat in battle against the Tibetans.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Zhengsheng he again served as grand general of the Shuofang Circuit, but soon was dismissed from office for defeat in battle against the Tibetans.

sentences.zh: 萬歳通天年，契丹李盡忠、孫萬榮反叛，復詔孝傑白衣起爲淸邊道總管，統兵十八萬以討之。

translations.literal: In the Wansui Tongtian era the Khitan Li Jinzhong and Sun Wanrong rebelled. Xiaojie was again ordered to rise in plain clothes as grand general of the Qingbian Circuit and command one hundred eighty thousand troops to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: In the Wansui Tongtian era the Khitan Li Jinzhong and Sun Wanrong rebelled. Xiaojie was again ordered to rise in plain clothes as grand general of the Qingbian Circuit and command one hundred eighty thousand troops to attack them.

sentences.zh: 孝傑軍至東峽石穀遇賊，道隘，虜甚眾，孝傑率精銳之士爲先鋒，且戰且前，及出穀，布方陣以捍賊。

translations.literal: When Xiaojie's army reached East Xiashi Valley it encountered the rebels. The road was narrow and the barbarians were very numerous. Xiaojie led elite troops as the vanguard, fighting as he advanced, and after leaving the valley deployed a square formation to resist the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: When Xiaojie's army reached East Xiashi Valley it encountered the rebels. The road was narrow and the barbarians were very numerous. Xiaojie led elite troops as the vanguard, fighting as he advanced, and after leaving the valley deployed a square formation to resist the enemy.

sentences.zh: 後軍總管蘇宏暉畏賊眾，棄甲而遁。

translations.literal: Su Honghui, deputy grand general of the rear army, feared the enemy's numbers, cast off his armor, and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Su Honghui, deputy grand general of the rear army, feared the enemy's numbers, cast off his armor, and fled.

sentences.zh: 孝傑既無後繼，爲賊所乘，營中潰亂，孝傑墮穀而死，兵士爲賊所殺及奔踐而死殆盡。

translations.literal: Xiaojie had no follow-up support and was overtaken by the enemy. The camp fell into disorder. Xiaojie fell into a ravine and died, and the soldiers were killed by the enemy or trampled to death in flight until nearly all were gone.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaojie had no follow-up support and was overtaken by the enemy. The camp fell into disorder. Xiaojie fell into a ravine and died, and the soldiers were killed by the enemy or trampled to death in flight until nearly all were gone.

sentences.zh: 時張說爲節度管記，馳奏其事。

translations.literal: At the time Zhang Yue was staff recorder of the frontier command and galloped to memorialize the matter.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Zhang Yue was staff recorder of the frontier command and galloped to memorialize the matter.

sentences.zh: 則天問孝傑敗亡之狀，說曰：「孝傑忠勇敢死，乃誠奉國，深入寇境，以少禦眾，但爲後援不至，所以致敗。」

translations.literal: Empress Wu asked about the circumstances of Xiaojie's defeat and death. Yue said: "Xiaojie was loyal, brave, and willing to die—truly devoted to the state. He penetrated deep into enemy territory and with few opposed many, but because rear support did not arrive, he was therefore defeated."
translations.idiomatic: Empress Wu asked about the circumstances of Xiaojie's defeat and death. Yue said, "Xiaojie was loyal, brave, and willing to die—truly devoted to the state. He penetrated deep into enemy territory and with few opposed many, but because rear support did not arrive, he was therefore defeated."

sentences.zh: 於是追贈孝傑夏官尚書，封耿國公。

translations.literal: Thereupon Xiaojie was posthumously promoted to Minister of War and enfeoffed as Duke of Geng.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Xiaojie was posthumously promoted to Minister of War and enfeoffed as Duke of Geng.

sentences.zh: 拜其子無擇爲朝散大夫。

translations.literal: His son Wuzhe was appointed Palace Gentleman for Dispersing Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: His son Wuzhe was appointed Palace Gentleman for Dispersing Affairs.

sentences.zh: 遣使斬宏暉以徇。

translations.literal: An envoy was sent to execute Honghui as a warning.
translations.idiomatic: An envoy was sent to execute Honghui as a warning.

sentences.zh: 使未至幽州，而宏暉已立功贖罪，竟免誅。

translations.literal: Before the envoy reached Youzhou, Honghui had already earned merit to redeem his crime and in the end escaped execution.
translations.idiomatic: Before the envoy reached Youzhou, Honghui had already earned merit to redeem his crime and in the end escaped execution.

sentences.zh: 開元中，無擇官至左驍衛將軍，以恩例贈孝傑特進。

translations.literal: In the Kaiyuan era Wuzhe reached the office of General of the Left Martial Courage Guard, and by grace Xiaojie was posthumously granted Special Advancement.
translations.idiomatic: In the Kaiyuan era Wuzhe reached the office of General of the Left Martial Courage Guard, and by grace Xiaojie was posthumously granted Special Advancement.

sentences.zh: 唐休璟，京兆始平人也。

translations.literal: Tang Xiujing was a native of Shiping in Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Xiujing was a native of Shiping in Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 曾祖規，周驃騎大將軍、安邑縣公。

translations.literal: His great-grandfather Gui was General of Fast Cavalry and Duke of Anyi in Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: His great-grandfather Gui was General of Fast Cavalry and Duke of Anyi in Zhou.

sentences.zh: 祖宗，隋大業末爲朔方郡丞。

translations.literal: His grandfather Zong, at the end of the Sui Daye era, was assistant prefect of Shuofang Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Zong, at the end of the Sui Daye era, was assistant prefect of Shuofang Commandery.

sentences.zh: 時爲梁師都舉兵，將據城，宗抗節不從，乃爲所害。

translations.literal: At that time Liang Shidu raised troops and was about to seize the city. Zong maintained integrity and would not follow, and was therefore killed.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Liang Shidu raised troops and was about to seize the city. Zong maintained integrity and would not follow, and was therefore killed.

sentences.zh: 休璟少以明經擢第。

translations.literal: Xiujing in youth passed the mingjing examination.
translations.idiomatic: Xiujing in youth passed the mingjing examination.

sentences.zh: 永徽中，解褐吳王府典簽，無異材，調授營州戸曹。

translations.literal: In the Yonghui era he took his first office as record keeper of the Prince of Wu's household. Showing no special talent, he was transferred and appointed revenue officer of Ying Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yonghui era he took his first office as record keeper of the Prince of Wu's household. Showing no special talent, he was transferred and appointed revenue officer of Ying Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 調露中，單於突厥背叛，誘扇奚、契丹侵掠州縣，後奚、羯胡又與桑乾突厥同反。

translations.literal: In the Diaolu era the Shanyu Turks rebelled, inciting the Xi and Khitan to raid prefectures and counties. Later the Xi and Jiehu again rebelled together with the Sanggan Turks.
translations.idiomatic: In the Diaolu era the Shanyu Turks rebelled, inciting the Xi and Khitan to raid prefectures and counties. Later the Xi and Jiehu again rebelled together with the Sanggan Turks.

sentences.zh: 都督周道務遣休璟將兵擊破之於獨護山，斬獲甚眾，超拜豐州司馬。

translations.literal: Governor Zhou Daowu sent Xiujing to lead troops and defeated them at Mount Duhu, beheading and capturing a great number. He was promoted beyond precedent to army marshal of Feng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Zhou Daowu sent Xiujing to lead troops and defeated them at Mount Duhu, beheading and capturing a great number. He was promoted beyond precedent to army marshal of Feng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 永淳中，突厥圍豐州，都督崔智辯戰歿。

translations.literal: In the Yongchun era the Turks besieged Feng Prefecture and Governor Cui Zhibian died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yongchun era the Turks besieged Feng Prefecture and Governor Cui Zhibian died in battle.

sentences.zh: 朝議欲罷豐州，徙百姓於靈、夏，休璟以爲不可，上書曰：「 豐州控河遏賊，實爲襟帶，自秦、漢已來，列爲郡縣，田疇良美，尤宜耕牧。

translations.literal: Court discussion wished to abolish Feng Prefecture and move the people to Ling and Xia. Xiujing thought this impossible and submitted a memorial, saying: "Feng Prefecture controls the river and checks the enemy—it is truly a strategic belt. From Qin and Han onward it has been listed as a commandery and county. Its fields are excellent and it is especially suited to farming and herding.
translations.idiomatic: Court discussion wished to abolish Feng Prefecture and move the people to Ling and Xia. Xiujing thought this impossible and submitted a memorial, saying, "Feng Prefecture controls the river and checks the enemy—it is truly a strategic belt. From Qin and Han onward it has been listed as a commandery and county. Its fields are excellent and it is especially suited to farming and herding.

sentences.zh: 隋季喪亂，不能堅守，乃遷徙百姓就寧、慶二州，致使戎羯交侵，乃以靈、夏爲邊界。

translations.literal: In the disorder at the end of Sui it could not be firmly held, and the people were moved to Ning and Qing prefectures, causing Rong and Jie to invade one another in turn, so that Ling and Xia became the border.
translations.idiomatic: In the disorder at the end of Sui it could not be firmly held, and the people were moved to Ning and Qing prefectures, causing Rong and Jie to invade one another in turn, so that Ling and Xia became the border.

sentences.zh: 貞觀之末，始募人以實之，西北一隅，方得寧謐。

translations.literal: At the end of Zhenguan people were first recruited to fill it, and the northwest corner alone then attained peace.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Zhenguan people were first recruited to fill it, and the northwest corner alone then attained peace.

sentences.zh: 今若廢棄，則河傍之地復爲賊有，靈、夏等州人不安業，非國家之利也。」

translations.literal: If it is now abandoned, the lands beside the river will again be possessed by the enemy, and the people of Ling, Xia, and other prefectures will be unable to settle in their occupations—this is not to the state's advantage."
translations.idiomatic: If it is now abandoned, the lands beside the river will again be possessed by the enemy, and the people of Ling, Xia, and other prefectures will be unable to settle in their occupations—this is not to the state's advantage."

sentences.zh: 朝廷從其言，豐州復存。

translations.literal: The court accepted his view, and Feng Prefecture was preserved.
translations.idiomatic: The court accepted his view, and Feng Prefecture was preserved.

sentences.zh: 垂拱中，遷安西副都護。

translations.literal: In the Chuigong era he was promoted to vice protector-general of Anxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the Chuigong era he was promoted to vice protector-general of Anxi.

sentences.zh: 會吐蕃攻破焉耆，安息道大總管、文昌右相韋待價及副使閻溫古失利，休璟收其餘眾，以安西土。

translations.literal: When the Tibetans broke Yanqi, the grand general of the Anxi Circuit and Right Vice Director Wei Daojia together with Vice Commissioner Yan Wengu suffered defeat. Xiujing gathered the remaining troops and stabilized the lands of Anxi.
translations.idiomatic: When the Tibetans broke Yanqi, the grand general of the Anxi Circuit and Right Vice Director Wei Daojia together with Vice Commissioner Yan Wengu suffered defeat. Xiujing gathered the remaining troops and stabilized the lands of Anxi.

sentences.zh: 遷西州都督，上表請復取四鎮。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Governor of Xizhou and submitted a memorial requesting recovery of the four garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Governor of Xizhou and submitted a memorial requesting recovery of the four garrisons.

sentences.zh: 則天遣王孝傑破吐蕃，拔四鎮，亦休璟之謀也。

translations.literal: Empress Wu sent Wang Xiaojie to break the Tibetans and recover the four garrisons—this too was Xiujing's plan.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Wu sent Wang Xiaojie to break the Tibetans and recover the four garrisons—this too was Xiujing's plan.

sentences.zh: 聖曆中，爲司衛卿，兼涼州都督、右肅政御史大夫，持節隴右諸軍州大使。

translations.literal: In the Shengli era he was Minister of the Court of Imperial Regalia, concurrently Governor of Liang Prefecture and Right Censor-in-Chief of the Bureau of Integrity, and held credentials as commissioner of the armies and prefectures of Longyou.
translations.idiomatic: In the Shengli era he was Minister of the Court of Imperial Regalia, concurrently Governor of Liang Prefecture and Right Censor-in-Chief of the Bureau of Integrity, and held credentials as commissioner of the armies and prefectures of Longyou.

sentences.zh: 久視元年秋，吐蕃大將麹莽布支率騎數萬寇涼州，入自洪源穀，將圍昌鬆縣。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the first year of Jiushi the Tibetan general Qu Mangbuzhi led tens of thousands of horsemen to raid Liang Prefecture, entering by Hongyuan Valley and about to besiege Changsong County.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the first year of Jiushi the Tibetan general Qu Mangbuzhi led tens of thousands of horsemen to raid Liang Prefecture, entering by Hongyuan Valley and about to besiege Changsong County.

sentences.zh: 休璟以數千人往擊之，臨陣登髙，望見賊衣甲鮮盛，謂麾下曰：「自欽陵死，讚婆降，麹莽布支新知賊兵，欲曜威武，故其國中貴臣酋豪子弟皆從之。

translations.literal: Xiujing went with several thousand men to attack them. On the battlefield he climbed high and, seeing the enemy's armor and weapons bright and fresh, said to his subordinates: "Since Qinling died and Zanpo surrendered, Qu Mangbuzhi has newly taken command of the enemy army and wishes to display martial power, so the noble ministers, tribal chiefs, and sons of the powerful in his state all follow him.
translations.idiomatic: Xiujing went with several thousand men to attack them. On the battlefield he climbed high and, seeing the enemy's armor and weapons bright and fresh, said to his subordinates, "Since Qinling died and Zanpo surrendered, Qu Mangbuzhi has newly taken command of the enemy army and wishes to display martial power, so the noble ministers, tribal chiefs, and sons of the powerful in his state all follow him.

sentences.zh: 人馬雖精，不習軍事，吾爲諸君取之。」

translations.literal: Though men and horses are elite, they are not practiced in military affairs. I will take them for you all."
translations.idiomatic: Though men and horses are elite, they are not practiced in military affairs. I will take them for you all."

sentences.zh: 乃被甲先登，與賊六戰六克，大破之，斬其副將二人，獲首二千五百級，築京觀而還。

translations.literal: Thereupon he donned armor and led the ascent. He fought the enemy six times and won six times, routed them completely, beheaded two of their deputy generals, captured two thousand five hundred heads, built a victory mound, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he donned armor and led the ascent. He fought the enemy six times and won six times, routed them completely, beheaded two of their deputy generals, captured two thousand five hundred heads, built a victory mound, and returned.

sentences.zh: 是後休璟入朝，吐蕃亦遣使來請和，因宴屢覘休璟。

translations.literal: Afterward Xiujing entered court, and the Tibetans also sent envoys to request peace. At the banquet they repeatedly scrutinized Xiujing.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward Xiujing entered court, and the Tibetans also sent envoys to request peace. At the banquet they repeatedly scrutinized Xiujing.

sentences.zh: 則天問其故，對曰：「往歳洪源戰時，此將軍雄猛無比，殺臣將士甚眾，故欲識之。」

translations.literal: Empress Wu asked the reason. They replied: "In the battle at Hongyuan last year this general was incomparably fierce and bold and killed many of our officers and soldiers, so we wished to recognize him."
translations.idiomatic: Empress Wu asked the reason. They replied, "In the battle at Hongyuan last year this general was incomparably fierce and bold and killed many of our officers and soldiers, so we wished to recognize him."

sentences.zh: 則天大加歎異，擢拜右武威、右金吾二衛大將軍。

translations.literal: Empress Wu greatly marveled and promoted him to Grand General of the Right Martial Power and Right Golden Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Wu greatly marveled and promoted him to Grand General of the Right Martial Power and Right Golden Guard.

sentences.zh: 休璟尤諳練邊事，自碣石西逾四鎮，綿亙萬里，山川要害，皆能記之。

translations.literal: Xiujing was especially well versed in frontier affairs. From Jieshi west beyond the four garrisons, stretching ten thousand li, he could remember every mountain pass and strategic point.
translations.idiomatic: Xiujing was especially well versed in frontier affairs. From Jieshi west beyond the four garrisons, stretching ten thousand li, he could remember every mountain pass and strategic point.

sentences.zh: 長安中，西突厥烏質勒與諸蕃不和，舉兵相持，安西道絕，表奏相繼。

translations.literal: In the Chang'an era the Western Turk Wuzhile was at odds with the various tribes and raised troops against one another. The Anxi route was cut off and memorials followed in succession.
translations.idiomatic: In the Chang'an era the Western Turk Wuzhile was at odds with the various tribes and raised troops against one another. The Anxi route was cut off and memorials followed in succession.

sentences.zh: 則天令休璟與宰相商度事勢，俄頃間草奏，便遣施行。

translations.literal: Empress Wu ordered Xiujing to consult with the chancellors on the situation. In a short while he drafted a memorial and it was immediately sent for execution.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Wu ordered Xiujing to consult with the chancellors on the situation. In a short while he drafted a memorial and it was immediately sent for execution.

sentences.zh: 後十餘日，安西諸州表請兵馬應接，程期一如休璟所畫。

translations.literal: More than ten days later the prefectures of Anxi submitted memorials requesting troops and horses for support, and the timing matched exactly what Xiujing had planned.
translations.idiomatic: More than ten days later the prefectures of Anxi submitted memorials requesting troops and horses for support, and the timing matched exactly what Xiujing had planned.

sentences.zh: 則天謂休璟曰：「恨用卿晚。」

translations.literal: Empress Wu said to Xiujing: "I regret employing you so late."
translations.idiomatic: Empress Wu said to Xiujing, "I regret employing you so late."

sentences.zh: 因遷夏官尚書、同鳳閣鸞台三品。

translations.literal: He was then promoted to Minister of War and Third Rank of the Phoenix Pavilion and Crane Terrace.
translations.idiomatic: He was then promoted to Minister of War and Third Rank of the Phoenix Pavilion and Crane Terrace.

sentences.zh: 又謂魏元忠及楊再思、李嶠、姚元崇、李迥秀等曰：「休璟諳練邊事，卿等十不當一也。」

translations.literal: She also said to Wei Yuanzhong, Yang Zaisi, Li Jiao, Yao Yuanchong, Li Jiongxiu, and others: "Xiujing is well versed in frontier affairs. Not one of you equals ten of him."
translations.idiomatic: She also said to Wei Yuanzhong, Yang Zaisi, Li Jiao, Yao Yuanchong, Li Jiongxiu, and others, "Xiujing is well versed in frontier affairs. Not one of you equals ten of him."

sentences.zh: 尋轉太子右庶子，依舊知政事。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to Right Vice Director of the Heir Apparent's Household and still managed state affairs as before.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was transferred to Right Vice Director of the Heir Apparent's Household and still managed state affairs as before.

sentences.zh: 以契丹入寇，復拜夏官尚書，兼檢校幽，營等州都督，兼安東都護。

translations.literal: Because the Khitan invaded, he was again appointed Minister of War and concurrently acting governor of You and Ying prefectures and Protector-General of Andong.
translations.idiomatic: Because the Khitan invaded, he was again appointed Minister of War and concurrently acting governor of You and Ying prefectures and Protector-General of Andong.

sentences.zh: 時中宗在春宮，將行，進啟於皇太子曰：「張易之兄弟幸蒙寵遇，數侍宴禁中，縱情失禮。

translations.literal: At the time Emperor Zhongzong was in the Eastern Palace. About to depart, he submitted a report to the Crown Prince, saying: "The brothers Zhang Yizhi have fortunately received favor and often attend banquets within the forbidden palace, indulging themselves beyond propriety.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Emperor Zhongzong was in the Eastern Palace. About to depart, he submitted a report to the Crown Prince, saying, "The brothers Zhang Yizhi have fortunately received favor and often attend banquets within the forbidden palace, indulging themselves beyond propriety.

sentences.zh: 非人臣之道，惟加防察。」

translations.literal: This is not the way of a minister—only strengthen watch and inspection."
translations.idiomatic: This is not the way of a minister—only strengthen watch and inspection."

sentences.zh: 中宗即位，召拜輔國大將軍、同中書門下三品，封酒泉郡公，顧謂曰：「卿曩日直言，朕今不忘。

translations.literal: When Zhongzong acceded, Xiujing was summoned and appointed Grand General of Assisting the State and Third Rank of the Secretariat and Chancellery, enfeoffed as Duke of Jiuquan. The emperor turned and said to him: "Your forthright words of old—I have not forgotten them today.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhongzong acceded, Xiujing was summoned and appointed Grand General of Assisting the State and Third Rank of the Secretariat and Chancellery, enfeoffed as Duke of Jiuquan. The emperor turned and said to him, "Your forthright words of old—I have not forgotten them today.

sentences.zh: 初欲召卿計事，但以遐遠，兼懷北狄之憂耳。」

translations.literal: At first I wished to summon you to consult on affairs, but because you were far away I also harbored concern over the northern barbarians."
translations.idiomatic: At first I wished to summon you to consult on affairs, but because you were far away I also harbored concern over the northern barbarians."

sentences.zh: 未幾，加特進，拜尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: Before long he was granted Special Advancement and appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was granted Special Advancement and appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 是歳秋，大水，休璟兩上表自咎，請免官甚切，辭多不載。

translations.literal: That autumn there were great floods. Xiujing twice submitted memorials blaming himself and requesting removal from office with great urgency. Most of the wording is not recorded.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn there were great floods. Xiujing twice submitted memorials blaming himself and requesting removal from office with great urgency. Most of the wording is not recorded.

sentences.zh: 中宗竟不允，手製答曰：「陰陽乖爽，事屬在予，待罪私門，難依來表。」

translations.literal: Zhongzong in the end did not consent and replied in his own hand: "Yin and yang are out of harmony—the matter lies with me. To await punishment at home is hard to accept from your memorial."
translations.idiomatic: Zhongzong in the end did not consent and replied in his own hand, "Yin and yang are out of harmony—the matter lies with me. To await punishment at home is hard to accept from your memorial."

sentences.zh: 尋遷中書令，充京師留守，俄加檢校吏部尚書。

translations.literal: Soon he was promoted to Director of the Secretariat, placed in charge as capital intendant, and shortly afterward additionally appointed acting Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was promoted to Director of the Secretariat, placed in charge as capital intendant, and shortly afterward additionally appointed acting Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 又以宮僚之舊，賜實封三百戸，累封宋國公。

translations.literal: Because of his old ties as a palace official, he was granted a real fief of three hundred households and repeatedly enfeoffed as Duke of Song.
translations.idiomatic: Because of his old ties as a palace official, he was granted a real fief of three hundred households and repeatedly enfeoffed as Duke of Song.

sentences.zh: 休璟在任，無所弘益。

translations.literal: While Xiujing held office he accomplished nothing of broad benefit.
translations.idiomatic: While Xiujing held office he accomplished nothing of broad benefit.

sentences.zh: 景龍二年，致仕於家，年力雖衰，進取彌銳。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jinglong he retired at home. Though his years and strength were declining, his ambition grew ever sharper.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jinglong he retired at home. Though his years and strength were declining, his ambition grew ever sharper.

sentences.zh: 時尚宮賀婁氏頗關預國政，憑附者皆得寵榮，休璟乃爲其子娶賀婁氏養女爲妻，因以自達。

translations.literal: At the time Lady Helou of the Inner Palace greatly intervened in state affairs, and those who attached themselves to her all obtained favor and glory. Xiujing therefore had his son marry Helou's adopted daughter as wife and thereby gained access.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Lady Helou of the Inner Palace greatly intervened in state affairs, and those who attached themselves to her all obtained favor and glory. Xiujing therefore had his son marry Helou's adopted daughter as wife and thereby gained access.

sentences.zh: 由是起爲太子少師、同中書門下三品，監修國史，仍封宋國公。

translations.literal: Thereby he was raised again as Junior Preceptor of the Heir Apparent and Third Rank of the Secretariat and Chancellery, supervised compilation of the national history, and still was enfeoffed as Duke of Song.
translations.idiomatic: Thereby he was raised again as Junior Preceptor of the Heir Apparent and Third Rank of the Secretariat and Chancellery, supervised compilation of the national history, and still was enfeoffed as Duke of Song.

sentences.zh: 休璟年逾八十，而不知止足，依托求進，爲時所譏。

translations.literal: Xiujing was over eighty years old and did not know when to stop, relying on connections to seek advancement, and was mocked by his contemporaries.
translations.idiomatic: Xiujing was over eighty years old and did not know when to stop, relying on connections to seek advancement, and was mocked by his contemporaries.

sentences.zh: 景雲元年，又拜特進，充朔方道行軍大總管，以備突厥，停其舊封，別賜實封一百戸。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jingyun he was again appointed Special Advancement and Grand General on campaign of the Shuofang Circuit to guard against the Turks. His old fief was suspended and a separate real fief of one hundred households was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jingyun he was again appointed Special Advancement and Grand General on campaign of the Shuofang Circuit to guard against the Turks. His old fief was suspended and a separate real fief of one hundred households was granted.

sentences.zh: 二年，表請致仕。

translations.literal: In the second year he submitted a memorial requesting retirement.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he submitted a memorial requesting retirement.

sentences.zh: 許之。

translations.literal: It was granted.
translations.idiomatic: It was granted.

sentences.zh: 祿及一品子課並令全給。

translations.literal: His salary and the stipend of a first-rank son were both ordered paid in full.
translations.idiomatic: His salary and the stipend of a first-rank son were both ordered paid in full.

sentences.zh: 休璟初得封時，以絹數千匹分散親族，又以家財數十萬大開塋域，備禮葬其五服之親，時人稱之。

translations.literal: When Xiujing first received his enfeoffment he distributed several thousand bolts of silk among his kin, and with several hundred thousand in household wealth he greatly opened a cemetery domain and buried his relatives within the five degrees of mourning with full rites. Men of the time praised him.
translations.idiomatic: When Xiujing first received his enfeoffment he distributed several thousand bolts of silk among his kin, and with several hundred thousand in household wealth he greatly opened a cemetery domain and buried his relatives within the five degrees of mourning with full rites. Men of the time praised him.

sentences.zh: 延和元年七月薨，年八十六，贈荊州大都督，諡曰忠。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the first year of Yanhe he died at age eighty-six. He was posthumously appointed Grand Governor of Jing Prefecture and given the posthumous title Zhong.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the first year of Yanhe he died at age eighty-six. He was posthumously appointed Grand Governor of Jing Prefecture and given the posthumous title Zhong.

sentences.zh: 子先慎襲爵，官至陳州刺史。

translations.literal: His son Xianshen inherited the title and reached the office of Prefect of Chen.
translations.idiomatic: His son Xianshen inherited the title and reached the office of Prefect of Chen.

sentences.zh: 次子先擇，開元中爲右金吾衛將軍。

translations.literal: His second son Xianze, in the Kaiyuan era, was General of the Right Golden Guard.
translations.idiomatic: His second son Xianze, in the Kaiyuan era, was General of the Right Golden Guard.

sentences.zh: 張仁愿，華州下邽人也。

translations.literal: Zhang Renyuan was a native of Xia Gui in Hua Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Renyuan was a native of Xia Gui in Hua Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 本名仁亶，以音類睿宗諱改焉。

translations.literal: His original name was Renyan; it was changed because the sound resembled the taboo name of Emperor Ruizong.
translations.idiomatic: His original name was Renyan; it was changed because the sound resembled the taboo name of Emperor Ruizong.

sentences.zh: 少有文武材幹，累遷殿中侍御史。

translations.literal: In youth he had both civil and military talent and was repeatedly promoted to palace censor.
translations.idiomatic: In youth he had both civil and military talent and was repeatedly promoted to palace censor.

sentences.zh: 時有御史郭霸上表稱則天是彌勒佛身，鳳閣舍人張嘉福與洛州人王慶之等請立武承嗣爲皇太子，皆請仁愿連名署表，仁愿正色拒之，甚爲有識所重。

translations.literal: At the time the censor Guo Ba submitted a memorial declaring that Empress Wu was the bodily incarnation of Maitreya Buddha. The Phoenix Pavilion Secretariat Officer Zhang Jiafu together with Wang Qingzhi of Luo Prefecture and others requested that Wu Chengsi be established as crown prince. All asked Renyuan to join in signing the memorial. Renyuan sternly refused, and was greatly valued by men of discernment.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the censor Guo Ba submitted a memorial declaring that Empress Wu was the bodily incarnation of Maitreya Buddha. The Phoenix Pavilion Secretariat Officer Zhang Jiafu together with Wang Qingzhi of Luo Prefecture and others requested that Wu Chengsi be established as crown prince. All asked Renyuan to join in signing the memorial. Renyuan sternly refused, and was greatly valued by men of discernment.

sentences.zh: 尋而夏官尚書王孝傑爲吐刺軍總管，統眾以禦吐蕃，詔仁愿往監之。

translations.literal: Soon Minister of War Wang Xiaojie was grand general of the Tuci Army and commanded the masses to defend against the Tibetans. Renyuan was ordered to go and supervise him.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Minister of War Wang Xiaojie was grand general of the Tuci Army and commanded the masses to defend against the Tibetans. Renyuan was ordered to go and supervise him.

sentences.zh: 仁愿與孝傑不協，因人奏事，稱孝傑軍誣罔之狀。

translations.literal: Renyuan was not in harmony with Xiaojie and, taking advantage of an audience, reported Xiaojie's army's false and deceptive conduct.
translations.idiomatic: Renyuan was not in harmony with Xiaojie and, taking advantage of an audience, reported Xiaojie's army's false and deceptive conduct.

sentences.zh: 孝傑由是免爲庶人，仁愿遽遷侍御史。

translations.literal: Xiaojie was thereby dismissed as a commoner, and Renyuan was swiftly promoted to attendant censor.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaojie was thereby dismissed as a commoner, and Renyuan was swiftly promoted to attendant censor.

sentences.zh: 萬歳通天二年，監察御史孫承景監淸邊軍，戰還，書戰圖以奏。

translations.literal: In the second year of Wansui Tongtian the supervising censor Sun Chengjing supervised the Qingbian Army. Returning from battle he drew battle maps and submitted them.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Wansui Tongtian the supervising censor Sun Chengjing supervised the Qingbian Army. Returning from battle he drew battle maps and submitted them.

sentences.zh: 每陣必畫承景躬當矢石、先鋒禦賊之狀，則天歎曰：「御史乃能盡誠如此！」

translations.literal: In every formation he necessarily drew Chengjing personally facing arrows and stones and leading the vanguard to resist the enemy. Empress Wu sighed and said: "A censor can be so utterly devoted!"
translations.idiomatic: In every formation he necessarily drew Chengjing personally facing arrows and stones and leading the vanguard to resist the enemy. Empress Wu sighed and said, "A censor can be so utterly devoted!"

sentences.zh: 擢拜右肅政台中丞，令仁愿敘錄承景下立功人。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Central Director of the Right Bureau of Integrity, and Renyuan was ordered to record those below Chengjing who had earned merit.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Central Director of the Right Bureau of Integrity, and Renyuan was ordered to record those below Chengjing who had earned merit.

sentences.zh: 仁愿未發都，先問承景對陣勝負之狀。

translations.literal: Before Renyuan departed the capital he first asked Chengjing about the circumstances of victory and defeat in the opposing formations.
translations.idiomatic: Before Renyuan departed the capital he first asked Chengjing about the circumstances of victory and defeat in the opposing formations.

sentences.zh: 承景身實不行，問之皆不能對，又虛增功狀。

translations.literal: Chengjing had in fact not gone himself; asked about it he could not answer anything, and he had falsely inflated the account of merit.
translations.idiomatic: Chengjing had in fact not gone himself; asked about it he could not answer anything, and he had falsely inflated the account of merit.

sentences.zh: 仁愿廷奏承景罔上之罪，於是左遷崇仁令，擢仁愿爲肅政台中丞、檢校幽州都督。

translations.literal: Renyuan memorialized at court Chengjing's crime of deceiving the sovereign. Thereupon Chengjing was demoted to magistrate of Chongren, and Renyuan was promoted to Central Director of the Bureau of Integrity and acting Governor of You Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Renyuan memorialized at court Chengjing's crime of deceiving the sovereign. Thereupon Chengjing was demoted to magistrate of Chongren, and Renyuan was promoted to Central Director of the Bureau of Integrity and acting Governor of You Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 會突厥默啜入寇，攻陷趙、定，擁眾回至幽州，仁愿勒兵出城邀擊之，流矢中手，賊亦引退。

translations.literal: When Mochuo of the Turks invaded, attacked, and captured Zhao and Ding and led his masses back to You Prefecture, Renyuan marshaled troops, went out of the city, and intercepted them. A stray arrow struck his hand and the enemy also withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: When Mochuo of the Turks invaded, attacked, and captured Zhao and Ding and led his masses back to You Prefecture, Renyuan marshaled troops, went out of the city, and intercepted them. A stray arrow struck his hand and the enemy also withdrew.

sentences.zh: 則天遣使勞問，賜以醫藥。

translations.literal: Empress Wu sent an envoy to express sympathy and bestowed medicine.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Wu sent an envoy to express sympathy and bestowed medicine.

sentences.zh: 累遷并州大都督府長史。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to prefectural governor of the Metropolitan Prefecture of Bing.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly promoted to prefectural governor of the Metropolitan Prefecture of Bing.

sentences.zh: 神龍二年，中宗還京，以仁愿爲左屯衛大將軍，兼檢校洛州長史。

translations.literal: In the second year of Shenlong Emperor Zhongzong returned to the capital and appointed Renyuan Grand General of the Left Garrison Guard and concurrently acting Prefect of Luo.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Shenlong Emperor Zhongzong returned to the capital and appointed Renyuan Grand General of the Left Garrison Guard and concurrently acting Prefect of Luo.

sentences.zh: 時都城穀貴，盜竊甚眾，仁愿一切皆捕獲杖殺之。

translations.literal: At the time grain in the capital was costly and theft was very numerous. Renyuan captured all of them and had them beaten to death.
translations.idiomatic: At the time grain in the capital was costly and theft was very numerous. Renyuan captured all of them and had them beaten to death.

sentences.zh: 積屍府門，遠近震懾，無敢犯者。

translations.literal: Corpses piled up at the prefectural gate. Near and far were shaken and awed, and none dared offend.
translations.idiomatic: Corpses piled up at the prefectural gate. Near and far were shaken and awed, and none dared offend.

sentences.zh: 初，髙宗時賈敦頤爲洛州刺史，亦有政績，與仁愿皆爲一時之最。

translations.literal: Earlier, in the Gaozong era Jia Dunyi was Prefect of Luo and also had administrative achievements. Both he and Renyuan were the foremost of their time.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, in the Gaozong era Jia Dunyi was Prefect of Luo and also had administrative achievements. Both he and Renyuan were the foremost of their time.

sentences.zh: 故時人爲之語曰：「洛州有前賈後張，可敵京兆三王。」

translations.literal: Therefore men of the time made a saying about them: "In Luo there are Jia before and Zhang after, a match for the three Wangs of Jingzhao."
translations.idiomatic: Therefore men of the time made a saying about them, "In Luo there are Jia before and Zhang after, a match for the three Wangs of Jingzhao."

sentences.zh: 其見稱如此。

translations.literal: They were praised to this extent.
translations.idiomatic: They were praised to this extent.

sentences.zh: 三年，突厥入寇。

translations.literal: In the third year the Turks invaded.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year the Turks invaded.

sentences.zh: 朔方軍總管沙吒忠義爲賊所敗。

translations.literal: Grand General of the Shuofang Army Shazha Zhongyi was defeated by the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Grand General of the Shuofang Army Shazha Zhongyi was defeated by the enemy.

sentences.zh: 詔仁愿攝御史大夫，代忠義統眾。

translations.literal: Renyuan was ordered to act as Censor-in-Chief and replace Zhongyi in commanding the masses.
translations.idiomatic: Renyuan was ordered to act as Censor-in-Chief and replace Zhongyi in commanding the masses.

sentences.zh: 仁愿至軍而賊眾已退，乃躡其後，夜掩大破之。

translations.literal: Renyuan reached the army but the enemy masses had already withdrawn. He then followed their tracks and by night launched a surprise attack, routing them completely.
translations.idiomatic: Renyuan reached the army but the enemy masses had already withdrawn. He then followed their tracks and by night launched a surprise attack, routing them completely.

sentences.zh: 先，朔方軍北與突厥以河爲界，河北岸有拂雲神祠。

translations.literal: Earlier, north of the Shuofang Army and the Turks took the river as boundary. On the north bank of the river was the Fuyun Spirit Shrine.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, north of the Shuofang Army and the Turks took the river as boundary. On the north bank of the river was the Fuyun Spirit Shrine.

sentences.zh: 突厥將入寇，必先詣祠祭酹求福，因牧馬料兵而後渡河。

translations.literal: When the Turks were about to invade they always first went to the shrine to offer sacrifice and libation and seek blessing, then pastured horses and gathered troops before crossing the river.
translations.idiomatic: When the Turks were about to invade they always first went to the shrine to offer sacrifice and libation and seek blessing, then pastured horses and gathered troops before crossing the river.

sentences.zh: 時突厥默啜盡眾西擊突騎施娑葛，仁愿請乘虛奪取漠南之地，於河北築三受降城，首尾相應，以絕其南寇之路。

translations.literal: At the time Mochuo of the Turks led his entire host west to attack the Turgesh Suoge. Renyuan requested to seize the vacant lands south of the desert and build three Accepting-Surrender cities north of the river in mutual support, to cut off their southern raiding route.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Mochuo of the Turks led his entire host west to attack the Turgesh Suoge. Renyuan requested to seize the vacant lands south of the desert and build three Accepting-Surrender cities north of the river in mutual support, to cut off their southern raiding route.

sentences.zh: 太子少師唐休璟以爲兩漢已來，皆北守黃河，今於寇境築城，恐勞人費功，終爲賊虜所有，建議以爲不便。

translations.literal: Junior Preceptor of the Heir Apparent Tang Xiujing thought that from the two Han dynasties onward all had held the Yellow River on the north. Now to build cities in enemy territory would, he feared, waste labor and effort and in the end become possessions of the enemy bandits. He submitted advice that it was inadvisable.
translations.idiomatic: Junior Preceptor of the Heir Apparent Tang Xiujing thought that from the two Han dynasties onward all had held the Yellow River on the north. Now to build cities in enemy territory would, he feared, waste labor and effort and in the end become possessions of the enemy bandits. He submitted advice that it was inadvisable.

sentences.zh: 仁愿固請不已，中宗竟從之。

translations.literal: Renyuan firmly requested without cease, and Zhongzong in the end followed him.
translations.idiomatic: Renyuan firmly requested without cease, and Zhongzong in the end followed him.

sentences.zh: 仁愿表留年滿鎮兵以助其功。

translations.literal: Renyuan submitted a memorial requesting that garrison troops whose terms had expired be retained to assist the work.
translations.idiomatic: Renyuan submitted a memorial requesting that garrison troops whose terms had expired be retained to assist the work.

sentences.zh: 時咸陽兵二百餘人逃歸，仁愿盡擒之，一時斬於城下，軍中股慄，役者盡力，六旬而三城俱就。

translations.literal: At the time more than two hundred Xianyang soldiers fled home. Renyuan captured them all and at once beheaded them below the city wall. The army trembled in fear and the laborers exerted all their strength. In sixty days all three cities were completed.
translations.idiomatic: At the time more than two hundred Xianyang soldiers fled home. Renyuan captured them all and at once beheaded them below the city wall. The army trembled in fear and the laborers exerted all their strength. In sixty days all three cities were completed.

sentences.zh: 以拂雲祠爲中城，與東、西兩城相去各四百餘里，皆據津濟，遙相應接，北拓地三百餘里，於牛頭朝那山北置烽候一千八百所。

translations.literal: The Fuyun Shrine became the middle city. East and west cities were each more than four hundred li apart, all occupying crossings, responding to one another from afar, extending the land northward more than three hundred li, and placing one thousand eight hundred beacon stations north of Mount Niutou Chaona.
translations.idiomatic: The Fuyun Shrine became the middle city. East and west cities were each more than four hundred li apart, all occupying crossings, responding to one another from afar, extending the land northward more than three hundred li, and placing one thousand eight hundred beacon stations north of Mount Niutou Chaona.

sentences.zh: 自是突厥不得度山放牧，朔方無復寇掠，減鎮兵數萬人。

translations.literal: From this the Turks could no longer cross the mountains to pasture, Shuofang had no further raids, and garrison troops were reduced by tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: From this the Turks could no longer cross the mountains to pasture, Shuofang had no further raids, and garrison troops were reduced by tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 仁愿初建三城，不置壅門及卻敵、戰格之具。

translations.literal: When Renyuan first built the three cities he did not install barrier gates, enemy-repelling structures, or battle frameworks.
translations.idiomatic: When Renyuan first built the three cities he did not install barrier gates, enemy-repelling structures, or battle frameworks.

sentences.zh: 或問曰：「此邊城禦賊之所，不爲守備，何也？」

translations.literal: Someone asked: "This is a frontier city for resisting the enemy—why make no defensive preparations?"
translations.idiomatic: Someone asked, "This is a frontier city for resisting the enemy—why make no defensive preparations?"

sentences.zh: 仁愿曰：「兵貴在攻取，不宜退守。

translations.literal: Renyuan said: "In warfare what is prized is attack and seizure, not withdrawal and defense.
translations.idiomatic: Renyuan said, "In warfare what is prized is attack and seizure, not withdrawal and defense.

sentences.zh: 寇若至此，即當並力出戰，回顧望城，猶須斬之，何用守備生其退恧之心也？」

translations.literal: If the enemy reaches here, one should at once combine strength and go out to fight. If one looks back toward the city one must still behead him—what use is there in defensive preparations that breed a mind of retreat and shame?"
translations.idiomatic: If the enemy reaches here, one should at once combine strength and go out to fight. If one looks back toward the city one must still behead him—what use is there in defensive preparations that breed a mind of retreat and shame?"

sentences.zh: 其後常元楷爲朔方軍總管，始築壅門以備寇，議者以此重仁愿而輕元楷焉。

translations.literal: Later Chang Yuankai was grand general of the Shuofang Army and first built barrier gates to guard against the enemy. Discussants therefore valued Renyuan more and Yuankai less.
translations.idiomatic: Later Chang Yuankai was grand general of the Shuofang Army and first built barrier gates to guard against the enemy. Discussants therefore valued Renyuan more and Yuankai less.

sentences.zh: 仁愿在朔方，奏用監察御史張敬忠、何鸞、長安尉寇、泚、鄠縣尉王易從、始平主簿劉體微分判軍事，太子文學柳彥昭爲管記，義烏尉晁良貞爲隨機。

translations.literal: While in Shuofang Renyuan memorialized employing supervising censors Zhang Jingzhong, He Luan, Chang'an magistrate Kou Bi, E county magistrate Wang Yicong, and Shiping chief clerk Liu Tiwai to divide and judge military affairs; Heir Apparent Literary Scholar Liu Yanzhao as staff recorder; and Yiwu magistrate Chao Liangzhen as adjutant.
translations.idiomatic: While in Shuofang Renyuan memorialized employing supervising censors Zhang Jingzhong, He Luan, Chang'an magistrate Kou Bi, E county magistrate Wang Yicong, and Shiping chief clerk Liu Tiwai to divide and judge military affairs; Heir Apparent Literary Scholar Liu Yanzhao as staff recorder; and Yiwu magistrate Chao Liangzhen as adjutant.

sentences.zh: 敬忠等皆以文吏著稱，多至大官，時稱仁愿有知人之鑒。

translations.literal: Jingzhong and the others were all famed as civil clerks and mostly reached high office. Men of the time said Renyuan had discernment in knowing men.
translations.idiomatic: Jingzhong and the others were all famed as civil clerks and mostly reached high office. Men of the time said Renyuan had discernment in knowing men.

sentences.zh: 景龍二年，拜左衛大將軍、同中書門下三品，累封韓國公。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jinglong he was appointed Grand General of the Left Guard and Third Rank of the Secretariat and Chancellery, and repeatedly enfeoffed as Duke of Han.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jinglong he was appointed Grand General of the Left Guard and Third Rank of the Secretariat and Chancellery, and repeatedly enfeoffed as Duke of Han.

sentences.zh: 春還朝，秋復督軍備邊。

translations.literal: In spring he returned to court; in autumn he again supervised troops to guard the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: In spring he returned to court; in autumn he again supervised troops to guard the frontier.

sentences.zh: 中宗賦詩祖餞，賞賜不可勝紀。

translations.literal: Emperor Zhongzong composed a poem to send him off and bestowed rewards beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Zhongzong composed a poem to send him off and bestowed rewards beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 尋加鎮軍大將軍。

translations.literal: Soon he was additionally appointed Grand General of the Pacifying Army.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was additionally appointed Grand General of the Pacifying Army.

sentences.zh: 睿宗即位，以老致仕，特全給祿俸，又拜兵部尚書，加光祿大夫，依舊致仕。

translations.literal: When Emperor Ruizong acceded he retired on account of age, but his salary was specially paid in full. He was again appointed Minister of War and granted Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, still retiring as before.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Ruizong acceded he retired on account of age, but his salary was specially paid in full. He was again appointed Minister of War and granted Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, still retiring as before.

sentences.zh: 開元二年卒，贈太子少傅，傅物二百段，命五品官一人爲監護使。

translations.literal: He died in the second year of Kaiyuan. He was posthumously appointed Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent, granted two hundred bolts of burial goods, and a fifth-rank official was appointed superintendent of funeral rites.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the second year of Kaiyuan. He was posthumously appointed Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent, granted two hundred bolts of burial goods, and a fifth-rank official was appointed superintendent of funeral rites.

sentences.zh: 子之輔，開元初爲趙州刺史。

translations.literal: His son Zhifu, at the beginning of Kaiyuan, was Prefect of Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: His son Zhifu, at the beginning of Kaiyuan, was Prefect of Zhao.

sentences.zh: 薛訥，絳州萬泉人也，左武衛大將軍仁貴子也。

translations.literal: Xue Ne was a native of Wanquan in Jiang Prefecture, son of Grand General of the Left Martial Guard Xue Rengui.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Ne was a native of Wanquan in Jiang Prefecture, son of Grand General of the Left Martial Guard Xue Rengui.

sentences.zh: 爲藍田令，有富商倪氏於御史台理其私債，中丞來俊臣受其貨財，斷出義倉米數千石以給之。

translations.literal: He was magistrate of Lantian. A wealthy merchant of the Ni clan had a private debt adjudicated at the Censorate. Central Director Lai Junchen accepted his bribes and ordered several thousand shi of charity-granary grain disbursed to him.
translations.idiomatic: He was magistrate of Lantian. A wealthy merchant of the Ni clan had a private debt adjudicated at the Censorate. Central Director Lai Junchen accepted his bribes and ordered several thousand shi of charity-granary grain disbursed to him.

sentences.zh: 訥曰：「義倉本備水旱，以爲儲蓄，安敢絕眾人之命，以資一家之產？」

translations.literal: Ne said: "The charity granary exists to prepare for flood and drought as stored reserve. How dare one cut off the lives of the multitude to enrich one household's property?"
translations.idiomatic: Ne said, "The charity granary exists to prepare for flood and drought as stored reserve. How dare one cut off the lives of the multitude to enrich one household's property?"

sentences.zh: 竟報上不與。

translations.literal: In the end he reported upward and did not grant it.
translations.idiomatic: In the end he reported upward and did not grant it.

sentences.zh: 會俊臣得罪，其事乃不行。

translations.literal: When Junchen fell into crime the matter was not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: When Junchen fell into crime the matter was not carried out.

sentences.zh: 其後突厥入寇河北，則天以訥將門，使攝左武威衛將軍、安東道經略。

translations.literal: Afterward when the Turks invaded Hebei, Empress Wu because Ne was from a general's house ordered him to act as General of the Left Martial Prestige Guard and commissioner of the Andong route.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward when the Turks invaded Hebei, Empress Wu because Ne was from a general's house ordered him to act as General of the Left Martial Prestige Guard and commissioner of the Andong route.

sentences.zh: 臨行，於同明殿召見與語，訥因奏曰：「醜虜恁淩，以盧陵爲辭。

translations.literal: On the eve of departure he was summoned to audience and conversation in Tongming Hall. Ne thereupon submitted: "The ugly barbarians rely on insolence and take Prince Luling as their pretext.
translations.idiomatic: On the eve of departure he was summoned to audience and conversation in Tongming Hall. Ne thereupon submitted, "The ugly barbarians rely on insolence and take Prince Luling as their pretext.

sentences.zh: 今雖有制升儲，外議猶恐未定。

translations.literal: Though there is now an edict elevating the heir, outside discussion still fears it is not settled.
translations.idiomatic: Though there is now an edict elevating the heir, outside discussion still fears it is not settled.

sentences.zh: 若此命不易，則狂賊自然款伏。」

translations.literal: If this command is not changed, the mad rebels will naturally submit in good faith."
translations.idiomatic: If this command is not changed, the mad rebels will naturally submit in good faith."

sentences.zh: 則天深然其言。

translations.literal: Empress Wu deeply approved his words.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Wu deeply approved his words.

sentences.zh: 尋拜幽州都督，兼安東都護。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed Governor of You and concurrently Protector-General of Andong.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was appointed Governor of You and concurrently Protector-General of Andong.

sentences.zh: 轉并州大都督府長史，兼檢校左衛大將軍。

translations.literal: He was transferred to prefectural governor of the Metropolitan Prefecture of Bing and concurrently acting Grand General of the Left Guard.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to prefectural governor of the Metropolitan Prefecture of Bing and concurrently acting Grand General of the Left Guard.

sentences.zh: 久當邊鎮之任，累有戰功。

translations.literal: Long holding frontier garrison duties, he repeatedly had battle merit.
translations.idiomatic: Long holding frontier garrison duties, he repeatedly had battle merit.

sentences.zh: 玄宗即位，於新豐講武，訥爲左軍節度。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xuanzong acceded, at Xinfeng he reviewed troops in martial display. Ne was commander of the left army.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xuanzong acceded, at Xinfeng he reviewed troops in martial display. Ne was commander of the left army.

sentences.zh: 時元帥與禮官得罪，諸部頗亦失序。

translations.literal: At the time the commander-in-chief and the ritual officer were punished, and the various units were also somewhat disordered.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the commander-in-chief and the ritual officer were punished, and the various units were also somewhat disordered.

sentences.zh: 唯訥及解琬之軍不動。

translations.literal: Only the armies of Ne and Jie Wan did not move.
translations.idiomatic: Only the armies of Ne and Jie Wan did not move.

sentences.zh: 玄宗令輕騎召訥等，至軍門，皆不得入。

translations.literal: Emperor Xuanzong ordered light cavalry to summon Ne and the others. Reaching the army gate, none were admitted.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuanzong ordered light cavalry to summon Ne and the others. Reaching the army gate, none were admitted.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，上甚加慰勞。

translations.literal: When the rites were completed the emperor greatly added words of comfort and reward.
translations.idiomatic: When the rites were completed the emperor greatly added words of comfort and reward.

sentences.zh: 時契丹及奚與突厥連和，屢爲邊患，訥建議請出師討之。

translations.literal: At the time the Khitan and Xi allied with the Turks and repeatedly became frontier troubles. Ne submitted advice requesting dispatch of troops to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the Khitan and Xi allied with the Turks and repeatedly became frontier troubles. Ne submitted advice requesting dispatch of troops to attack them.

sentences.zh: 開元二年夏，詔與左監門將軍杜賓客、定州刺史崔宣道等率眾二萬，出檀州道以討契丹等。

translations.literal: In the summer of the second year of Kaiyuan he was ordered together with Left Gate General Du Binke, Prefect of Ding Cui Xuandao, and others to lead twenty thousand men and go out by the Tan route to attack the Khitan and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the second year of Kaiyuan he was ordered together with Left Gate General Du Binke, Prefect of Ding Cui Xuandao, and others to lead twenty thousand men and go out by the Tan route to attack the Khitan and others.

sentences.zh: 杜賓客以爲時屬炎暑，將土負戈甲，齎資糧，深入寇境，恐難爲製勝。

translations.literal: Du Binke thought that the season was hot summer, the soldiers would bear armor and carry provisions, and penetrating deep into enemy territory would be hard to use for assured victory.
translations.idiomatic: Du Binke thought that the season was hot summer, the soldiers would bear armor and carry provisions, and penetrating deep into enemy territory would be hard to use for assured victory.

sentences.zh: 中書令姚元崇亦以爲然。

translations.literal: Director of the Secretariat Yao Yuanchong also thought so.
translations.idiomatic: Director of the Secretariat Yao Yuanchong also thought so.

sentences.zh: 訥獨曰：「夏月草茂，羔犢生息之際，不費糧儲，亦可漸進。

translations.literal: Ne alone said: "In summer the grass is lush—it is the season when lambs and calves are born and reared. Without expending grain stores one may also advance gradually.
translations.idiomatic: Ne alone said, "In summer the grass is lush—it is the season when lambs and calves are born and reared. Without expending grain stores one may also advance gradually.

sentences.zh: 一舉振國威靈，不可失也。」

translations.literal: One stroke to shake the state's martial majesty must not be missed."
translations.idiomatic: One stroke to shake the state's martial majesty must not be missed."

sentences.zh: 時議鹹以爲不便。

translations.literal: At the time discussion all thought it inadvisable.
translations.idiomatic: At the time discussion all thought it inadvisable.

sentences.zh: 玄宗方欲威服四夷，特令訥同紫微黃門三品，總兵擊奚、契丹，議者乃息。

translations.literal: Emperor Xuanzong wished to awe the four barbarians by force and specially ordered Ne Third Rank of the Purple Palace and Yellow Gate and overall commander to strike the Xi and Khitan, and discussants then ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuanzong wished to awe the four barbarians by force and specially ordered Ne Third Rank of the Purple Palace and Yellow Gate and overall commander to strike the Xi and Khitan, and discussants then ceased.

sentences.zh: 六月，師至灤河，遇賊，時既蒸暑，諸將失計會，盡爲契丹等所覆。

translations.literal: In the sixth month the army reached the Luan River and encountered the enemy. The season was already steaming hot and the generals lost coordination. All were overrun by the Khitan and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the army reached the Luan River and encountered the enemy. The season was already steaming hot and the generals lost coordination. All were overrun by the Khitan and others.

sentences.zh: 訥脫身走免，歸罪於崔宣道及蕃將李思敬等八人，詔盡令斬之，特免杜賓客之罪。

translations.literal: Ne escaped with his body and shifted blame to Cui Xuandao and the barbarian general Li Sijing and eight others. An edict ordered all beheaded and Du Binke's crime specially remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Ne escaped with his body and shifted blame to Cui Xuandao and the barbarian general Li Sijing and eight others. An edict ordered all beheaded and Du Binke's crime specially remitted.

sentences.zh: 下製曰：「并州大都督府長史兼檢校左衛大將軍、和戎大武等諸軍州節度大使、同紫微黃門三品薛訥，總戎禦邊，建議爲首。

translations.literal: An edict was issued, saying: "Xue Ne, prefectural governor of the Metropolitan Prefecture of Bing, concurrently acting Grand General of the Left Guard, Commissioner of the Armies and Prefectures of He Rong Da Wu and other circuits, and Third Rank of the Purple Palace and Yellow Gate, overall commanded troops to defend the frontier and was foremost in submitting the plan.
translations.idiomatic: An edict was issued, saying, "Xue Ne, prefectural governor of the Metropolitan Prefecture of Bing, concurrently acting Grand General of the Left Guard, Commissioner of the Armies and Prefectures of He Rong Da Wu and other circuits, and Third Rank of the Purple Palace and Yellow Gate, overall commanded troops to defend the frontier and was foremost in submitting the plan.

sentences.zh: 暗於料敵，輕於接戰，張我王師，衄之虜境。

translations.literal: He was dark in estimating the enemy and light in joining battle, displayed our royal army, and suffered defeat in barbarian territory.
translations.idiomatic: He was dark in estimating the enemy and light in joining battle, displayed our royal army, and suffered defeat in barbarian territory.

sentences.zh: 觀其疇昔，頗常輸罄，每欲資忠報主，見義忘身。

translations.literal: Observing his past conduct, he has often been utterly defeated, yet each time wished to support loyalty and repay his lord, seeing righteousness and forgetting his person.
translations.idiomatic: Observing his past conduct, he has often been utterly defeated, yet each time wished to support loyalty and repay his lord, seeing righteousness and forgetting his person.

sentences.zh: 特緩嚴刑，俾期來效，宜赦其罪，所有官爵等並從除削。」

translations.literal: His severe punishment is specially relaxed so that he may come to future merit. His crime should be pardoned, and all offices and titles are removed and stripped."
translations.idiomatic: His severe punishment is specially relaxed so that he may come to future merit. His crime should be pardoned, and all offices and titles are removed and stripped."

sentences.zh: 其年八月，吐蕃大將坌達延、乞力徐等率眾十萬寇臨洮軍，又進寇蘭州及渭州之渭源縣，掠群牧而去。

translations.literal: That year, in the eighth month, the Tibetan generals Benda Yan, Qili Xu, and others led one hundred thousand men to raid the Lin Tao Army and further advanced to raid Lan Prefecture and Weiyuan County in Wei Prefecture, plundering the herd pastures before departing.
translations.idiomatic: That year, in the eighth month, the Tibetan generals Benda Yan, Qili Xu, and others led one hundred thousand men to raid the Lin Tao Army and further advanced to raid Lan Prefecture and Weiyuan County in Wei Prefecture, plundering the herd pastures before departing.

sentences.zh: 詔訥白衣攝左羽林將軍，爲隴右防禦使，與大仆少卿王晙等率兵邀擊之。

translations.literal: Ne was ordered in plain clothes to act as General of the Left Feathered Forest and defensive commissioner of Longyou, and together with Vice Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud Wang Jun and others to lead troops and intercept them.
translations.idiomatic: Ne was ordered in plain clothes to act as General of the Left Feathered Forest and defensive commissioner of Longyou, and together with Vice Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud Wang Jun and others to lead troops and intercept them.

sentences.zh: 十月，訥領眾至渭源，遇賊戰於武階驛，與王晙掎角夾攻之，大破賊眾。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Ne led his masses to Weiyuan and encountered the enemy in battle at Wujie Post. Together with Wang Jun he attacked from converging angles and routed the enemy masses completely.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Ne led his masses to Weiyuan and encountered the enemy in battle at Wujie Post. Together with Wang Jun he attacked from converging angles and routed the enemy masses completely.

sentences.zh: 追奔至洮水，又戰於長城堡，豐安軍使王海賓先鋒力戰死之。

translations.literal: Pursuing the flight to the Tao River they again fought at Changcheng Fort. Feng'an Army Commissioner Wang Haibin died in the vanguard fighting with all his strength.
translations.idiomatic: Pursuing the flight to the Tao River they again fought at Changcheng Fort. Feng'an Army Commissioner Wang Haibin died in the vanguard fighting with all his strength.

sentences.zh: 將士乘勢進擊，又敗之，殺獲萬人，擒其將六指鄉彌洪，盡收其所掠羊馬，並獲其器械，不可勝數。

translations.literal: Officers and soldiers took advantage of the momentum to press the attack and again defeated them, killing and capturing ten thousand men, capturing the enemy general Liuzhi Xiangmihong, recovering all the sheep and horses they had plundered, and obtaining their weapons beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: Officers and soldiers took advantage of the momentum to press the attack and again defeated them, killing and capturing ten thousand men, capturing the enemy general Liuzhi Xiangmihong, recovering all the sheep and horses they had plundered, and obtaining their weapons beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 時有詔將以十二月親征吐蕃，及聞訥等克捷，玄宗大悅，乃停親征。

translations.literal: At the time there was an edict that in the twelfth month the emperor would personally campaign against the Tibetans. When he heard of Ne's and the others' victory Emperor Xuanzong was greatly pleased and stopped the personal campaign.
translations.idiomatic: At the time there was an edict that in the twelfth month the emperor would personally campaign against the Tibetans. When he heard of Ne's and the others' victory Emperor Xuanzong was greatly pleased and stopped the personal campaign.

sentences.zh: 追贈王海賓左金吾衛大將軍，賜物三百段、粟三百石，名其稚子爲忠嗣，拜朝散大夫。

translations.literal: Wang Haibin was posthumously promoted to Grand General of the Left Golden Guard, granted three hundred bolts of goods and three hundred shi of grain, his infant son was named Zhongsi and appointed Palace Gentleman for Dispersing Affairs.
