translations.idiomatic: Wang Haibin was posthumously promoted to Grand General of the Left Golden Guard, granted three hundred bolts of goods and three hundred shi of grain, his infant son was named Zhongsi and appointed Palace Gentleman for Dispersing Affairs.

sentences.zh: 命紫微舍人倪若水往，即便敘錄功狀，拜訥爲左羽林軍大將軍，復封平陽郡公，仍拜子暢朝散大夫。

translations.literal: Purple Palace Secretariat Officer Ni Ruoshui was ordered to go and at once record the account of merit. Ne was appointed Grand General of the Left Feathered Forest Army, again enfeoffed as Duke of Pingyang, and his son Chang was appointed Palace Gentleman for Dispersing Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Purple Palace Secretariat Officer Ni Ruoshui was ordered to go and at once record the account of merit. Ne was appointed Grand General of the Left Feathered Forest Army, again enfeoffed as Duke of Pingyang, and his son Chang was appointed Palace Gentleman for Dispersing Affairs.

sentences.zh: 俄又充涼州鎮軍大總管。

translations.literal: Soon he was again appointed Grand General of the Pacifying Army of Liang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was again appointed Grand General of the Pacifying Army of Liang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 尋以年老，特聽致仕。

translations.literal: Soon because of old age he was specially permitted to retire.
translations.idiomatic: Soon because of old age he was specially permitted to retire.

sentences.zh: 八年卒，年七十餘，贈太常卿，諡曰昭定。

translations.literal: He died in the eighth year at age over seventy. He was posthumously appointed Minister of Ceremonies and given the posthumous title Zhaoding.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the eighth year at age over seventy. He was posthumously appointed Minister of Ceremonies and given the posthumous title Zhaoding.

sentences.zh: 訥沉勇寡言，臨大敵而益壯。

translations.literal: Ne was deep, brave, and sparing of speech, and before a great enemy grew all the bolder.
translations.idiomatic: Ne was deep, brave, and sparing of speech, and before a great enemy grew all the bolder.

sentences.zh: 訥弟楚玉，開元中，爲幽州大都督府長史，以不稱職見代而卒。

translations.literal: Ne's younger brother Chuyu, in the Kaiyuan era, was prefectural governor of You and was replaced for incompetence and died.
translations.idiomatic: Ne's younger brother Chuyu, in the Kaiyuan era, was prefectural governor of You and was replaced for incompetence and died.

sentences.zh: 王晙，滄州景城人，徙家於洛陽。

translations.literal: Wang Jun was a native of Jingcheng in Cang Prefecture and moved his household to Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jun was a native of Jingcheng in Cang Prefecture and moved his household to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 祖有方，岷州刺史。

translations.literal: His grandfather Youfang was Prefect of Min.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Youfang was Prefect of Min.

sentences.zh: 晙弱冠明經擢第，曆遷殿中侍御史，加朝散大夫。

translations.literal: Jun at his coming of age passed the mingjing examination and was repeatedly promoted to palace censor, with additional rank as Palace Gentleman for Dispersing Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Jun at his coming of age passed the mingjing examination and was repeatedly promoted to palace censor, with additional rank as Palace Gentleman for Dispersing Affairs.

sentences.zh: 時朔方軍元帥魏元忠討賊失利，歸罪於副將韓思忠，奏請誅之。

translations.literal: At the time the commander-in-chief of the Shuofang Army Wei Yuanzhong attacked the enemy without success and shifted blame to Deputy General Han Sizhong, memorializing a request to execute him.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the commander-in-chief of the Shuofang Army Wei Yuanzhong attacked the enemy without success and shifted blame to Deputy General Han Sizhong, memorializing a request to execute him.

sentences.zh: 晙以思忠既是偏裨，製不由已，又有勇智可惜，不可獨殺非辜，乃廷議爭之。

translations.literal: Jun thought that Sizhong, being a subordinate commander, was not master of his own orders and also had courage and wisdom worth sparing—he could not be killed alone while innocent. He therefore disputed it at court.
translations.idiomatic: Jun argued that Sizhong, as a subordinate commander, was not master of his own orders and had courage and wisdom worth sparing—he could not be executed alone while innocent. He therefore disputed the matter at court.

sentences.zh: 思忠竟得釋，而晙亦由是出爲渭南令。

translations.literal: Sizhong in the end was released, and Jun was therefore sent out as magistrate of Weinan.
translations.idiomatic: Sizhong in the end was released, and Jun was therefore sent out as magistrate of Weinan.

sentences.zh: 景龍未，累轉爲桂州都督。

translations.literal: At the end of Jinglong he was repeatedly transferred and became Governor of Gui.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Jinglong he was repeatedly transferred and became Governor of Gui.

sentences.zh: 桂州舊有屯兵，常運衡、永等州糧以饋之，晙始改築羅郭，奏罷屯兵及轉運。

translations.literal: Gui Prefecture formerly had garrison troops who regularly transported grain from Heng and Yong prefectures to supply them. Jun first rebuilt the outer wall, memorialized abolition of the garrison troops and transport.
translations.idiomatic: Gui Prefecture formerly had garrison troops who regularly transported grain from Heng and Yong prefectures to supply them. Jun first rebuilt the outer wall, memorialized abolition of the garrison troops and transport.

sentences.zh: 又堰江水，開屯田數千頃，百姓賴之。

translations.literal: He also dammed the river water and opened several thousand qing of garrison fields. The people relied on this.
translations.idiomatic: He also dammed the river water and opened several thousand qing of garrison fields. The people relied on this.

sentences.zh: 尋上疏請歸鄉拜墓，州人詣闕請留晙，乃下敕曰：「彼州往緣寇盜，戸口凋殘，委任失材，乃令至此。

translations.literal: Soon he submitted a memorial requesting return home to visit the tombs. The people of the prefecture went to the palace to request that Jun be retained, and an edict was issued, saying: "That prefecture in the past because of bandits and robbers had declining households and wasted population, and appointment lost the right men, which led to this.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he submitted a memorial requesting return home to visit the tombs. The people of the prefecture went to the palace to request that Jun be retained, and an edict was issued, saying, "That prefecture in the past because of bandits and robbers had declining households and wasted population, and appointment lost the right men, which led to this.

sentences.zh: 卿處事強濟，遠邇寧靜，築城務農，利益已廣，隱括綏緝，復業者多。

translations.literal: You handle affairs with force and success; far and near are quiet. Building walls and devoting effort to farming—the benefit is already broad. Hidden registration, pacification, and gathering—many have returned to their occupations.
translations.idiomatic: You handle affairs with force and success; far and near are quiet. Building walls and devoting effort to farming—the benefit is already broad. Hidden registration, pacification, and gathering—many have returned to their occupations.

sentences.zh: 宜須政成，安此黎庶，百姓又有表請，不須來也。」

translations.literal: Governance must be completed and these common people settled. The people have again submitted memorials requesting it—you need not come."
translations.idiomatic: Governance must be completed and these common people settled. The people have again submitted memorials requesting it—you need not come."

sentences.zh: 晙在州又一年，州人立碑以頌其政。

translations.literal: Jun remained in the prefecture one more year, and the people of the prefecture erected a stele to praise his administration.
translations.idiomatic: Jun remained in the prefecture one more year, and the people of the prefecture erected a stele to praise his administration.

sentences.zh: 再轉鴻臚大卿，充朔方軍副大總管，兼安西大都護，豐安、定遠、三城及側近軍並受晙節度。

translations.literal: He was again transferred to Minister of Ceremonial Reception and appointed Deputy Grand General of the Shuofang Army and Grand Protector-General of Anxi. The Feng'an, Dingyuan, and Three Cities armies and nearby forces all received Jun's command.
translations.idiomatic: He was again transferred to Minister of Ceremonial Reception and appointed Deputy Grand General of the Shuofang Army and Grand Protector-General of Anxi. The Feng'an, Dingyuan, and Three Cities armies and nearby forces all received Jun's command.

sentences.zh: 後轉太仆少卿、隴右群牧使。

translations.literal: Later he was transferred to Vice Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud and Commissioner of the Herd Pastures of Longyou.
translations.idiomatic: Later he was transferred to Vice Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud and Commissioner of the Herd Pastures of Longyou.

sentences.zh: 開元二年，吐蕃精甲十萬寇臨洮軍，晙率所部二千人卷甲倍程，與臨洮兩軍合勢以拒之。

translations.literal: In the second year of Kaiyuan one hundred thousand elite Tibetan armored troops raided the Lin Tao Army. Jun led his command of two thousand men in rolled armor at double pace and combined strength with the two Lin Tao armies to resist them.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Kaiyuan one hundred thousand elite Tibetan armored troops raided the Lin Tao Army. Jun led his command of two thousand men in rolled armor at double pace and combined strength with the two Lin Tao armies to resist them.

sentences.zh: 賊營於大來穀口，吐蕃將坌達延又率兵繼至。

translations.literal: The enemy encamped at Dalai Valley mouth, and the Tibetan general Benda Yan again led troops in succession to arrive.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy encamped at Dalai Valley mouth, and the Tibetan general Benda Yan again led troops in succession to arrive.

sentences.zh: 晙乃出奇兵七百人，衣之蕃服，夜襲之。

translations.literal: Jun then sent seven hundred surprise troops dressed in barbarian clothing and raided them by night.
translations.idiomatic: Jun then sent seven hundred surprise troops dressed in barbarian clothing and raided them by night.

sentences.zh: 相去五里，置鼓角，令前者遇寇大呼，後者擊鼓以應之。

translations.literal: Five li apart he placed drums and horns, ordering those in front upon encountering the enemy to shout loudly and those behind to beat drums in response.
translations.idiomatic: Five li apart he placed drums and horns, ordering those in front upon encountering the enemy to shout loudly and those behind to beat drums in response.

sentences.zh: 賊眾大懼，疑有伏兵，自相殺傷，死者萬計。

translations.literal: The enemy masses were greatly terrified, suspected an ambush, and killed and wounded one another. The dead were beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy masses were greatly terrified, suspected an ambush, and killed and wounded one another. The dead were beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 俄而攝右羽林將軍薛訥率眾邀擊吐蕃，至武階穀，去大來穀二十里，爲賊所隔。

translations.literal: Soon Acting General of the Right Feathered Forest Xue Ne led masses to intercept the Tibetans and reached Wujie Valley, twenty li from Dalai Valley, and was blocked by the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Acting General of the Right Feathered Forest Xue Ne led masses to intercept the Tibetans and reached Wujie Valley, twenty li from Dalai Valley, and was blocked by the enemy.

sentences.zh: 晙率兵迎訥之軍，賊置兵於兩軍之間，連亙數十里。

translations.literal: Jun led troops to meet Ne's army. The enemy placed troops between the two armies, stretching continuously for several tens of li.
translations.idiomatic: Jun led troops to meet Ne's army. The enemy placed troops between the two armies, stretching continuously for several tens of li.

sentences.zh: 晙夜出壯士銜枚擊之，賊又大潰。

translations.literal: Jun by night sent strong men with gags in their mouths to strike them, and the enemy again fled in complete rout.
translations.idiomatic: Jun by night sent strong men with gags in their mouths to strike them, and the enemy again fled in complete rout.

sentences.zh: 乃與訥合軍，掩其餘眾，追奔至洮水，殺獲不可勝數，盡收所掠牧馬而還。

translations.literal: Thereupon he joined armies with Ne, enveloped the remaining masses, pursued the flight to the Tao River, killed and captured beyond counting, recovered all the plundered herd horses, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he joined armies with Ne, enveloped the remaining masses, pursued the flight to the Tao River, killed and captured beyond counting, recovered all the plundered herd horses, and returned.

sentences.zh: 以功加銀青光祿大夫，封淸源縣男，兼原州都督，仍拜其子班爲朝散大夫。

translations.literal: For merit he was granted Silver Blue-Glazed Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, enfeoffed as Baron of Qingyuan County, concurrently Governor of Yuan Prefecture, and his son Ban was appointed Palace Gentleman for Dispersing Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: For merit he was granted Silver Blue-Glazed Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, enfeoffed as Baron of Qingyuan County, concurrently Governor of Yuan Prefecture, and his son Ban was appointed Palace Gentleman for Dispersing Affairs.

sentences.zh: 尋除并州大都督府長史。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed prefectural governor of the Metropolitan Prefecture of Bing.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was appointed prefectural governor of the Metropolitan Prefecture of Bing.

sentences.zh: 明年，突厥默啜爲九姓所殺，其下酋長多款塞投降，置之河曲之內。

translations.literal: The next year Mochuo of the Turks was killed by the Nine Surnames. The tribal chiefs below mostly submitted to the frontier in good faith and were placed within the River Bend.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Mochuo of the Turks was killed by the Nine Surnames. The tribal chiefs below mostly submitted to the frontier in good faith and were placed within the River Bend.

sentences.zh: 俄而小殺繼立，降者漸叛。

translations.literal: Soon Xiaosha succeeded and the submitters gradually rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Xiaosha succeeded and the submitters gradually rebelled.

sentences.zh: 晙上疏曰：

translations.literal: Jun submitted a memorial, saying:
translations.idiomatic: Jun submitted a memorial, saying:

sentences.zh: 望至秋冬之際，令朔方軍盛陳兵馬，告其禍福，啗以繒帛之利，示以麋鹿之饒，說其魚米之鄉，陳其畜牧之地。

translations.literal: I hope that by the autumn and winter season the Shuofang Army may grandly display troops and horses, inform them of fortune and misfortune, entice them with the profit of silks and brocades, show them the abundance of deer and elk, speak to them of lands rich in fish and rice, and set forth places for herding and grazing.
translations.idiomatic: I hope that by the autumn and winter season the Shuofang Army may grandly display troops and horses, inform them of fortune and misfortune, entice them with the profit of silks and brocades, show them the abundance of deer and elk, speak to them of lands rich in fish and rice, and set forth places for herding and grazing.

sentences.zh: 並分配淮南、河南寬鄉安置，仍給程糧，送至配所。

translations.literal: All should be distributed and settled in broad townships of Huainan and Henan, still given travel grain and escorted to their assigned places.
translations.idiomatic: All should be distributed and settled in broad townships of Huainan and Henan, still given travel grain and escorted to their assigned places.

sentences.zh: 雖復一時勞弊，必得久長安穩。

translations.literal: Though there will be temporary labor and hardship, long-term peace and stability will surely be obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Though there will be temporary labor and hardship, long-term peace and stability will surely be obtained.

sentences.zh: 二十年外，漸染淳風，將以充兵，皆爲勁卒。

translations.literal: After twenty years they will gradually be imbued with pure custom, and when they fill the armies all will be strong soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: After twenty years they will gradually be imbued with pure custom, and when they fill the armies all will be strong soldiers.

sentences.zh: 若以北狄降者不可南中安置，則髙麗俘虜置之沙漠之曲，西域編氓散在青、徐之右，唯利是視，務安疆埸，何獨降胡，不可移徙。

translations.literal: If northern barbarian submitters cannot be settled in the south, then should Goguryeo captives be placed in desert bends and western-region registered people scattered east of Qing and Xu—only profit is considered and frontier peace is sought. Why should submitter Hu alone be immovable?
translations.idiomatic: If northern barbarian submitters cannot be settled in the south, then should Goguryeo captives be placed in desert bends and western-region registered people scattered east of Qing and Xu—only profit is considered and frontier peace is sought. Why should submitter Hu alone be immovable?

sentences.zh: 近者，在邊將士，爰及安蕃使人，多作諛辭，不爲實對。

translations.literal: Recently frontier officers and soldiers, as well as envoys pacifying the barbarians, often make flattering words and do not answer according to fact.
translations.idiomatic: Recently frontier officers and soldiers, as well as envoys pacifying the barbarians, often make flattering words and do not answer according to fact.

sentences.zh: 或言北虜破滅，或言降戸安靜，誌欲自言功效，非有以徇邦家。

translations.literal: Some say the northern barbarians are destroyed, or that submitter households are quiet—intending to speak of their own achievements, not truly to serve the state and family.
translations.idiomatic: Some say the northern barbarians are destroyed, or that submitter households are quiet—intending to speak of their own achievements, not truly to serve the state and family.

sentences.zh: 伏願察斯利口，行茲遠慮，邊荒淸晏，黎元幸甚。

translations.literal: I humbly wish you to examine these smooth tongues and carry out this far-sighted plan. If the frontier wilderness is clear and quiet, the common people will be greatly fortunate.
translations.idiomatic: I humbly wish you to examine these smooth tongues and carry out this far-sighted plan. If the frontier wilderness is clear and quiet, the common people will be greatly fortunate.

sentences.zh: 臣料留住之議，謀者雲遵故事，必言降戸之輩，舊置河曲之中，昔年既得康寧，今日還應穩便。

translations.literal: I anticipate that those who advocate retaining them will say we should follow precedent and will surely say that submitter masses of old were placed within the River Bend, and since peace was once obtained the present arrangement should again be stable.
translations.idiomatic: I anticipate that those who advocate retaining them will say we should follow precedent and will surely say that submitter masses of old were placed within the River Bend, and since peace was once obtained the present arrangement should again be stable.

sentences.zh: 但同時異事，先典攸傳。

translations.literal: But the same time differs in events—ancient canons transmit this.
translations.idiomatic: But the same time differs in events—ancient canons transmit this.

sentences.zh: 往者頡利破亡，邊境寧謐，降戸之輩，無復他心，所以多曆歳年，此類皆無動靜。

translations.literal: In the past when Jieli was destroyed the frontier was quiet and submitter masses had no further other minds, so for many years this kind had no movement at all.
translations.idiomatic: In the past when Jieli was destroyed the frontier was quiet and submitter masses had no further other minds, so for many years this kind had no movement at all.

sentences.zh: 今虜見未破滅，降戸私使往來，或畏北虜之威，或懷北虜之惠，又是北虜戚屬，夫豈不識親疏，將比昔年，安可同日！

translations.literal: Now the barbarians see they are not yet destroyed; submitter households privately send envoys back and forth, either fearing the northern barbarians' might or cherishing the northern barbarians' favor—and they are also kin of the northern barbarians. How would they not know near from far? Compared with former years, how can it be the same day!
translations.idiomatic: Now the barbarians see they are not yet destroyed; submitter households privately send envoys back and forth, either fearing the northern barbarians' might or cherishing the northern barbarians' favor—and they are also kin of the northern barbarians. How would they not know near from far? Compared with former years, how can it be the same day!

sentences.zh: 臣料其中頗有三策。

translations.literal: I anticipate that among them there are roughly three strategies.
translations.idiomatic: I anticipate that among them there are roughly three strategies.

sentences.zh: 若盛陳兵馬，散令分配，內獲精兵之實，外袪黠虜之謀，暫勞永安，此上策也。

translations.literal: If troops and horses are grandly displayed and orders given to distribute them, within one obtains the reality of elite soldiers and without one dispels cunning barbarian plots—temporary labor for lasting peace: this is the upper strategy.
translations.idiomatic: If troops and horses are grandly displayed and orders given to distribute them, within one obtains the reality of elite soldiers and without one dispels cunning barbarian plots—temporary labor for lasting peace: this is the upper strategy.

sentences.zh: 若多屯士卒，廣爲備擬，亭障之地，蕃、漢相參，費甚人勞，此下策也。

translations.literal: If many garrison troops are stationed and preparations broadly made, with barbarian and Han mixed at beacon posts—great expense of wealth and labor: this is the lower strategy.
translations.idiomatic: If many garrison troops are stationed and preparations broadly made, with barbarian and Han mixed at beacon posts—great expense of wealth and labor: this is the lower strategy.

sentences.zh: 若置之朔塞，任之來往，通傳信息，結成禍胎，此無策也。

translations.literal: If they are placed in the northern frontier and allowed to come and go, transmitting information and forming seeds of disaster: this is no strategy at all.
translations.idiomatic: If they are placed in the northern frontier and allowed to come and go, transmitting information and forming seeds of disaster: this is no strategy at all.

sentences.zh: 伏願察斯三者，詳其善惡，利害之狀，長短可尋。

translations.literal: I humbly wish you to examine these three, detail their good and bad—the shape of benefit and harm, long and short can be traced.
translations.idiomatic: I humbly wish you to examine these three, detail their good and bad—the shape of benefit and harm, long and short can be traced.

sentences.zh: 縱因遷移，或致逃叛，但有移得之者，即是今日良圖，留待河冰，恐即有變。

translations.literal: Even if migration should cause flight and rebellion, whoever is obtained by moving them is today's good plan. To wait for the river ice may fear immediate change.
translations.idiomatic: Even if migration should cause flight and rebellion, whoever is obtained by moving them is today's good plan. To wait for the river ice may fear immediate change.

sentences.zh: 臣蒙天澤，叨居重鎮，逆耳利行，敢不盡言。

translations.literal: Your subject has received heaven's grace and presumptuously holds a weighty post. What benefits the state though it offends the ear—how dare I not speak fully?
translations.idiomatic: Your subject has received heaven's grace and presumptuously holds a weighty post. What benefits the state though it offends the ear—how dare I not speak fully?

sentences.zh: 疏奏未報，降虜果叛，敕晙帥并州兵西濟河以討之。

translations.literal: The memorial was submitted without reply. The submitter barbarians indeed rebelled. An edict ordered Jun to lead Bing Prefecture troops west across the river to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was submitted without reply. The submitter barbarians indeed rebelled. An edict ordered Jun to lead Bing Prefecture troops west across the river to attack them.

sentences.zh: 晙乃間行倍道，以夜繼晝，卷甲舍幕而趨之。

translations.literal: Jun then traveled by hidden routes at double pace, continuing day from night, rolling armor and abandoning tents as he hastened.
translations.idiomatic: Jun then traveled by hidden routes at double pace, continuing day from night, rolling armor and abandoning tents as he hastened.

sentences.zh: 夜於山中忽遇風雪甚盛，晙恐失期，仰天誓曰：「晙若事君不忠，不討有罪，明靈所殛，固自當之，而士眾何辜，令其艱苦！

translations.literal: By night in the mountains he suddenly encountered very heavy wind and snow. Jun feared missing the deadline and swore to heaven, saying: "If Jun serves his lord without loyalty and does not punish the guilty, let the spirits strike me—I alone should bear it. But what crime have the soldiers that they should suffer such hardship!
translations.idiomatic: By night in the mountains he suddenly encountered very heavy wind and snow. Jun feared missing the deadline and swore to heaven, saying, "If Jun serves his lord without loyalty and does not punish the guilty, let the spirits strike me—I alone should bear it. But what crime have the soldiers that they should suffer such hardship!

sentences.zh: 若誠心忠烈，天監孔明，當止雪回風，以濟戎事。」

translations.literal: If my heart is truly loyal and fierce, heaven's scrutiny is bright and clear—let the snow stop and the wind turn back to aid the military affair."
translations.idiomatic: If my heart is truly loyal and fierce, heaven's scrutiny is bright and clear—let the snow stop and the wind turn back to aid the military affair."

sentences.zh: 言訖，風回而雪止。

translations.literal: When the words were finished the wind turned back and the snow stopped.
translations.idiomatic: When the words were finished the wind turned back and the snow stopped.

sentences.zh: 時叛者分爲兩道，其在東者，晙追及之，殺一千五百餘人，生獲一千四百餘人，駝馬牛羊甚眾。

translations.literal: At the time the rebels divided into two routes. Those in the east Jun overtook and killed more than one thousand five hundred men, captured alive more than one thousand four hundred men, and camels, horses, cattle, and sheep in great number.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the rebels divided into two routes. Those in the east Jun overtook and killed more than one thousand five hundred men, captured alive more than one thousand four hundred men, and camels, horses, cattle, and sheep in great number.

sentences.zh: 晙以功遷左散騎常侍、持節朔方道行軍大總管，尋遷御史大夫。

translations.literal: For merit Jun was promoted to Left Regular Attendant and Grand General on campaign of the Shuofang Circuit with credentials, and soon promoted to Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: For merit Jun was promoted to Left Regular Attendant and Grand General on campaign of the Shuofang Circuit with credentials, and soon promoted to Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 時突厥夾跌部落及仆固都督勺磨等散在受降城左右居止，且謀引突厥共爲表裏，陷軍城而叛。

translations.literal: At the time the Jiedie tribal division of the Turks and Protector-General Taomo of the Pugu and others were scattered living around the Accepting-Surrender cities and plotted to bring in the Turks as inner and outer together to trap the garrison cities and rebel.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the Jiedie tribal division of the Turks and Protector-General Taomo of the Pugu and others were scattered living around the Accepting-Surrender cities and plotted to bring in the Turks as inner and outer together to trap the garrison cities and rebel.

sentences.zh: 晙因入奏，密請誅之。

translations.literal: Jun therefore entered to memorialize and secretly requested their execution.
translations.idiomatic: Jun therefore entered to memorialize and secretly requested their execution.

sentences.zh: 八年秋，晙誘夾跌等黨與八百餘人於中受降城誅之，由是乃授晙兵部尚書，復充朔方軍大總管。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the eighth year Jun lured more than eight hundred partisans of Jiedie and others and executed them at the Middle Accepting-Surrender City. Thereby Jun was appointed Minister of War and again appointed Grand General of the Shuofang Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the eighth year Jun lured more than eight hundred partisans of Jiedie and others and executed them at the Middle Accepting-Surrender City. Thereby Jun was appointed Minister of War and again appointed Grand General of the Shuofang Army.

sentences.zh: 九年，蘭池州胡苦於賦役，誘降虜餘燼，攻夏州反叛，詔隴右節度使、羽林將軍郭知運與晙相知討之。

translations.literal: In the ninth year the Lan Chi Prefecture Hu, bitter over tax and corvée labor, incited the remaining flames of submitter barbarians to attack Xia Prefecture and rebel. An edict ordered Longyou Military Commissioner and Feathered Forest General Guo Zhiyun to join forces with Jun in attacking them.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year the Lan Chi Prefecture Hu, bitter over tax and corvée labor, incited the remaining flames of submitter barbarians to attack Xia Prefecture and rebel. An edict ordered Longyou Military Commissioner and Feathered Forest General Guo Zhiyun to join forces with Jun in attacking them.

sentences.zh: 晙奏：「朔方軍兵自有餘力，其郭知運請還本軍。」

translations.literal: Jun memorialized: "The Shuofang Army troops have strength to spare. Guo Zhiyun should be ordered back to his original army."
translations.idiomatic: Jun memorialized, "The Shuofang Army troops have strength to spare. Guo Zhiyun should be ordered back to his original army."

sentences.zh: 未報，而知運兵至，與晙頗不相協。

translations.literal: Before reply Zhiyun's army arrived and was rather not in harmony with Jun.
translations.idiomatic: Before reply Zhiyun's army arrived and was rather not in harmony with Jun.

sentences.zh: 晙所招撫降者，知運縱兵擊之，賊以爲晙所賣，皆相率叛走。

translations.literal: Those submitters Jun had summoned and pacified Zhiyun led troops to attack. The rebels thought Jun had sold them out and all joined in fleeing and rebelling.
translations.idiomatic: Those submitters Jun had summoned and pacified Zhiyun led troops to attack. The rebels thought Jun had sold them out and all joined in fleeing and rebelling.

sentences.zh: 晙進封淸源縣公，仍兼御史大夫。

translations.literal: Jun was advanced in enfeoffment to Duke of Qingyuan County and still concurrently Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Jun was advanced in enfeoffment to Duke of Qingyuan County and still concurrently Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 俄而賊眾復相結聚，晙坐左遷梓州刺史。

translations.literal: Soon the rebel masses again gathered together. Jun was demoted for the fault to Prefect of Zi.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the rebel masses again gathered together. Jun was demoted for the fault to Prefect of Zi.

sentences.zh: 十年，拜太子詹事，累封中山郡公。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was appointed Supervisor of the Heir Apparent's Household and repeatedly enfeoffed as Duke of Zhongshan Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was appointed Supervisor of the Heir Apparent's Household and repeatedly enfeoffed as Duke of Zhongshan Commandery.

sentences.zh: 屬車駕北巡，以晙爲吏部尚書，兼太原尹。

translations.literal: When the imperial carriage toured north he was appointed Minister of Personnel and concurrently Prefect of Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial carriage toured north he was appointed Minister of Personnel and concurrently Prefect of Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 十一年夏，代張說爲兵部尚書、同中書門下三品，追錄破胡之功，加金紫光祿大夫，仍充朔方軍節度大使。

translations.literal: In the summer of the eleventh year he replaced Zhang Yue as Minister of War and Third Rank of the Secretariat and Chancellery, recorded merit for breaking the Hu, was granted Golden Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, and still appointed Military Commissioner of the Shuofang Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the eleventh year he replaced Zhang Yue as Minister of War and Third Rank of the Secretariat and Chancellery, recorded merit for breaking the Hu, was granted Golden Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, and still appointed Military Commissioner of the Shuofang Army.

sentences.zh: 其年冬，上親郊祀，追晙赴京，以會大禮。

translations.literal: That winter the emperor personally performed suburban sacrifice and recalled Jun to the capital to attend the great rite.
translations.idiomatic: That winter the emperor personally performed suburban sacrifice and recalled Jun to the capital to attend the great rite.

sentences.zh: 晙以時屬冰壯，恐虜騎乘隙入寇，表辭不赴，手敕慰勉，仍賜衣一副。

translations.literal: Jun because the season was strong ice feared barbarian horsemen would seize the gap and invade. He submitted a memorial declining to come. An edict in the emperor's hand comforted and encouraged him and still bestowed one set of robes.
translations.idiomatic: Jun because the season was strong ice feared barbarian horsemen would seize the gap and invade. He submitted a memorial declining to come. An edict in the emperor's hand comforted and encouraged him and still bestowed one set of robes.

sentences.zh: 會許州刺史王喬家奴告喬與晙潛謀構逆，敕侍中源乾曜、中書令張說鞫其狀。

translations.literal: When Prefect of Xu Wang Qiao's household slave reported that Qiao and Jun secretly plotted treason, an edict ordered Director of the Chancellery Yuan Qianyao and Director of the Secretariat Zhang Yue to investigate the facts.
translations.idiomatic: When Prefect of Xu Wang Qiao's household slave reported that Qiao and Jun secretly plotted treason, an edict ordered Director of the Chancellery Yuan Qianyao and Director of the Secretariat Zhang Yue to investigate the facts.

sentences.zh: 晙既無反狀，乃以違詔追不到，左遷蘄州刺史。

translations.literal: Jun had no sign of rebellion and was therefore demoted for disobeying the edict in not arriving in time to Prefect of Qi.
translations.idiomatic: Jun had no sign of rebellion and was therefore demoted for disobeying the edict in not arriving in time to Prefect of Qi.

sentences.zh: 十四年，累遷戸部尚書，復爲朔方軍節度使。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was repeatedly promoted to Minister of Revenue and again became Military Commissioner of the Shuofang Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he was repeatedly promoted to Minister of Revenue and again became Military Commissioner of the Shuofang Army.

sentences.zh: 二十年卒，年七十餘，贈尚書左丞相，諡曰忠烈。

translations.literal: He died in the twentieth year at age over seventy. He was posthumously appointed Left Director of the Department of State Affairs and given the posthumous title Zhonglie.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the twentieth year at age over seventy. He was posthumously appointed Left Director of the Department of State Affairs and given the posthumous title Zhonglie.

sentences.zh: 往歳，魏元忠爲張易之、昌宗所構，左授髙要尉，晙密狀申明之。

translations.literal: In former years Wei Yuanzhong was framed by Zhang Yizhi and Changzong and demoted to Assistant Magistrate of Gaoyao. Jun secretly memorialized to clarify the matter.
translations.idiomatic: In former years Wei Yuanzhong was framed by Zhang Yizhi and Changzong and demoted to Assistant Magistrate of Gaoyao. Jun secretly memorialized to clarify the matter.

sentences.zh: 宋璟時爲鳳閣舍人，謂晙曰：「魏公且全矣，子須威嚴而坐理，恐子之狼狽也。」

translations.literal: Song Jing at the time was Phoenix Pavilion Secretariat Officer and said to Jun: "Lord Wei will be safe, but you must sit in judgment with stern dignity—I fear you will be thrown into disorder."
translations.idiomatic: Song Jing at the time was Phoenix Pavilion Secretariat Officer and said to Jun, "Lord Wei will be safe, but you must sit in judgment with stern dignity—I fear you will be thrown into disorder."

sentences.zh: 晙曰：「魏公忠而獲罪，晙爲義所激，顛沛無恨。」

translations.literal: Jun said: "Lord Wei was loyal yet punished. Jun was stirred by righteousness and has no regret in hardship."
translations.idiomatic: Jun said, "Lord Wei was loyal yet punished. Jun was stirred by righteousness and has no regret in hardship."

sentences.zh: 璟歎曰：「璟不能申魏公之枉，深負朝廷矣。」

translations.literal: Jing sighed and said: "Jing could not clarify Lord Wei's wrong. I have deeply failed the court."
translations.idiomatic: Jing sighed and said, "Jing could not clarify Lord Wei's wrong. I have deeply failed the court."

sentences.zh: 晙氣貌雄壯，時人謂之有熊虎之狀。

translations.literal: Jun's bearing was heroic and strong. Men of the time said he had the appearance of bear and tiger.
translations.idiomatic: Jun's bearing was heroic and strong. Men of the time said he had the appearance of bear and tiger.

sentences.zh: 然慕義激勵，有古人之風，禦下整肅，人吏畏而愛之。

translations.literal: Yet he admired righteousness and was stirred to action, having the air of ancients. In commanding subordinates he was orderly and strict; clerks and officials both feared and loved him.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he admired righteousness and was stirred to action, having the air of ancients. In commanding subordinates he was orderly and strict; clerks and officials both feared and loved him.

sentences.zh: 晙卒後，信安王禕於幽州討奚告捷，奏稱軍士鹹見晙與蕃將髙昭領兵馬先軍討賊，上聞而嗟異久之。

translations.literal: After Jun died, Prince Xin'an Yi in You Prefecture attacked the Xi and reported victory, memorializing that soldiers all saw Jun together with the barbarian general Gao Zhao leading troops and horses as the vanguard army attacking the enemy. The emperor heard and marveled for a long time.
translations.idiomatic: After Jun died, Prince Xin'an Yi in You Prefecture attacked the Xi and reported victory, memorializing that soldiers all saw Jun together with the barbarian general Gao Zhao leading troops and horses as the vanguard army attacking the enemy. The emperor heard and marveled for a long time.

sentences.zh: 戸部郎中楊伯城上疏，請晙等墳特乞增修封域，量加表異，降使饗祭，優其子孫。

translations.literal: Director in the Ministry of Revenue Yang Bocheng submitted a memorial requesting that Jun's and others' tombs specially be granted enlarged burial domains and marked distinctions, with envoys sent to offer sacrifice and their sons and grandsons favored.
translations.idiomatic: Director in the Ministry of Revenue Yang Bocheng submitted a memorial requesting that Jun's and others' tombs specially be granted enlarged burial domains and marked distinctions, with envoys sent to offer sacrifice and their sons and grandsons favored.

sentences.zh: 玄宗乃遣使就其家廟祭，仍如其子官秩。

translations.literal: Emperor Xuanzong then sent an envoy to offer sacrifice at his household shrine, still according to the rank of his son.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuanzong then sent an envoy to offer sacrifice at his household shrine, still according to the rank of his son.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：婁師德應召而慷愾，勇也；

translations.literal: The historiographer says: Lou Shide answered the summons with generous indignation—courage;
translations.idiomatic: The historiographer says: Lou Shide answered the summons with generous indignation—courage;

sentences.zh: 薦仁傑而入用，忠也；

translations.literal: recommended Renjie and put him to use—loyalty;
translations.idiomatic: recommended Renjie and put him to use—loyalty;

sentences.zh: 不使仁傑知之，公也；

translations.literal: did not let Renjie know it—impartiality;
translations.idiomatic: did not let Renjie know it—impartiality;

sentences.zh: 營田贍軍，智也；

translations.literal: garrison agriculture to supply the army—wisdom;
translations.idiomatic: garrison agriculture to supply the army—wisdom;

sentences.zh: 恭勤接下，和也；

translations.literal: respectful diligence in receiving subordinates—harmony;
translations.idiomatic: respectful diligence in receiving subordinates—harmony;

sentences.zh: 參知政事，功名有卒，是人之難也，又何愧於將相乎！

translations.literal: participated in managing state affairs and preserved reputation and office to the end—this is what is hard for a man. How could he be ashamed before generals and chancellors!
translations.idiomatic: participated in managing state affairs and preserved reputation and office to the end—this is what is hard for a man. How could he be ashamed before generals and chancellors!

sentences.zh: 王孝傑，唐休璟、張仁愿、薛訥、王晙等，皆韜武幹，亟立邊功。

translations.literal: Wang Xiaojie, Tang Xiujing, Zhang Renyuan, Xue Ne, Wang Jun, and others all concealed martial capacity and repeatedly established frontier merit.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xiaojie, Tang Xiujing, Zhang Renyuan, Xue Ne, Wang Jun, and others all concealed martial capacity and repeatedly established frontier merit.

sentences.zh: 然孝傑失於再擒，休璟虧於餘行。

translations.literal: Yet Xiaojie failed in being twice captured; Xiujing was deficient in his later conduct.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Xiaojie failed in being twice captured; Xiujing was deficient in his later conduct.

sentences.zh: 先敗後勝，薛訥何慚；

translations.literal: Defeat first and victory afterward—what shame has Xue Ne?
translations.idiomatic: Defeat first and victory afterward—what shame has Xue Ne?

sentences.zh: 止雪回風，王晙難掩；

translations.literal: Stopping snow and turning back the wind—Wang Jun is hard to conceal;
translations.idiomatic: Stopping snow and turning back the wind—Wang Jun is hard to conceal;

sentences.zh: 仁愿操履，中否相兼。

translations.literal: Renyuan's conduct mixed the acceptable and the unacceptable.
translations.idiomatic: Renyuan's conduct mixed the acceptable and the unacceptable.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：拯物之心，不形於色。

translations.literal: The encomium says: A heart to support others does not show on the face.
translations.idiomatic: The encomium says: A heart to support others does not show on the face.

sentences.zh: 將相之材，人何以測。

translations.literal: The material of generals and chancellors—how can men measure it?
translations.idiomatic: The material of generals and chancellors—how can men measure it?

sentences.zh: 臣有始終，功無爽忒。

translations.literal: Ministers have beginning and end; merit is without deviation.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers have beginning and end; merit is without deviation.

sentences.zh: 多忌梁公，自招慚德。

translations.literal: Much jealousy toward Lord Liang—self-invited shame upon one's virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Much jealousy toward Lord Liang—self-invited shame upon one's virtue.

sentences.zh: 唐、張、訥、晙，善陣能師。

translations.literal: Tang, Zhang, Ne, and Jun—good at formations, able as commanders.
translations.idiomatic: Tang, Zhang, Ne, and Jun—good at formations, able as commanders.

sentences.zh: 共服戎虜，不憂邊陲。

translations.literal: Together they subdued the martial barbarians and did not worry over the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Together they subdued the martial barbarians and did not worry over the frontier.
